title: Senior IT Analyst Applications
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Roles And Responsibilities****

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

****Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications****

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

****What You Will Have****
**Business Analysis:**
Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.
  
  
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.
  
  
**Analytical Thinking:**
Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.
  
  
**Application Delivery Process:**
Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.
  
  
**System and Technology Integration:**
Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.
  
  
**Software Quality Management:**
Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.
  
  
**Problem Management:**
Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.
  
  
**Information Security Technologies:**
Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management:**
Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.
  
  
****What Success Looks Like****

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

****What You Will Get****

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

****Additional Information****
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Process Excellence and Transformation- Associate
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving measurable efficiency and transformation across CCB F&BM. Yes? You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, Process Excellence & Transformation within CCB Finance & Business Management (F&BM), you will spend each day building a centralized, persona-driven engagement model and creating a single source of truth for transformation use cases. You will be responsible for delivering quantifiable improvements through AI use cases, standardized governance, disciplined program/project management, and Lean (DMAIC) practices.
  
  
Our CCB F&BM transformation teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including identifying and prioritizing efficiency opportunities across sub‑LOBs, establishing consistent operating models and governance routines, and executing change that improves outcomes in a sustainable, well-controlled way.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain a living “golden resource” linking Team ↔ Technology ↔ Change Journey across sub‑LOBs.
* Design and operationalize a centralized, persona-driven engagement model, mapping job families to impacted users, themes, and adoption requirements.
* Source, intake, and prioritize thematic efficiency and AI transformation use cases across sub‑LOBs using standardized forms and processes.
* Document team/tool ownership, impacted processes, current status, and a 12–24 month roadmap to create a single source of truth.

+ Scale proof-of-concept work into production-ready artifacts that can be used in strategy discussions and before launching new use cases.
+ Align priorities and outcomes with sub‑LOB leadership (N‑1), clarifying ownership, decisions, and success measures.

* Standardize execution through Agile discipline and governance routines, including JIRA hygiene, review checkpoints, and timely sign-offs.
* Partner with Controls stakeholders to align initiatives to Controls OKRs, streamline SOPs, and identify control-aligned efficiency opportunities.
* Coordinate delivery with STO/execution partners by managing dependencies, tracking progress, and escalating risks and delays.
* Maintain a single authoritative repository for historical, current, and pipeline transformation work and enable leadership visibility via JIRA dashboards.
* Lead Lean (DMAIC) deep-dives to deliver measurable, systemic improvements with sub‑LOB sign-off and adoption.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  
  

* Demonstrate 6+ years of experience in process excellence, transformation, program/project management, or operational strategy (financial services beneficial).
* Lead cross-functional workstreams with senior stakeholder alignment, including N‑1 engagement and decision-making.
* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Python, Pyspark, Alteryx
* Execute disciplined intake-to-delivery lifecycle management, including governance cadence, dependency/risk management, and closure.
* Apply hands-on Agile delivery practices and use JIRA for tracking, reporting, and dashboarding.
* Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including executive-ready updates and crisp decision asks.
* Build and sustain an adopted “golden resource” mapping Team–Tool–Process–Change Journey with a 12–24 month outlook.
* Deliver measurable outcomes through standardized operating models, reusable repositories, and end-to-end workstreams with documented stakeholder buy-in.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  
  

* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Databricks, Snowflake, Atoti, Sigma, Tableau

+ Apply exposure to intelligent automation and analytics enablement and adoption in enterprise environments.

* Hold Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt/Black Belt) or demonstrate successful DMAIC delivery experience.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Manager, Delivery Management
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**

Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.
  
  
Q2 is seeking a dynamic and experienced Technical Delivery Manager to
**join the Leadership Team of the Service Delivery Centre of Excellence (CoE).**

The Technical Delivery Manager will play a critical role in overseeing the successful delivery of our digital banking solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and driving continuous improvement in our delivery processes.

.

* Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resources, identifying and mitigating risks and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team, promoting knowledge sharing and collaboration.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and internal teams, to drive alignment and achieve business objectives.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, providing recommendations and insights to senior leadership.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in IT, with a proven track record of technical leadership.
* Minimum of 2 years of people leadership is a must have.
* Prior experience (hands-on experience will be an added advantage) with tools like Bit bucket, Jenkins, SQL, Nomad, Vault, Splunk, JIRA & Salesforce.
* A knack for identifying and implementing automation solutions, best practices, process improvement to drive efficiency.
* Proven experience building, mentoring and motivating high-performance teams.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to interface effectively at all levels.
* A calm, diplomatic approach to problem-solving, especially under pressure.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with enterprise software deployment architecture and Agile methodologies.
* Background in Financial Services and enterprise software is a plus.

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Python)
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer (SDET) to join NetApp’s ONTAP Engineering team, focusing on SAN and block storage solutions. ONTAP is a feature-rich storage platform used in mission-critical environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.As an Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation pipelines that ensure high product quality for complex distributed storage systems. You will work across multiple subsystems, understand end-to-end customer workflows, and drive quality at scale.This is an advanced IC role requiring strong technical depth, ownership of features/modules, and the ability to operate with limited supervision while influencing test strategy, automation direction, and cross-team quality outcomes.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and related technologies
* Own end-to-end validation for SAN/block storage features, including test design, execution, and defect lifecycle management
* Collaborate with development teams to understand feature design, define validation strategies, and drive testability improvements early in the cycle.
* Develop functional, integration, stress, and scale tests for distributed storage systems
* Drive automation-first testing approaches and improve code/test coverage across components
* Analyze failures, debug complex issues across software layers, and drive root cause resolution.
* Participate in product design discussions and contribute to improving reliability, observability, and diagnosability
* Lead or significantly contribute to test planning, quality reviews, and release readiness.
* Work across cross-functional teams (Dev, QA, Field Support) to understand customer use cases and ensure production readiness.
* Mentor junior engineers and influence engineering best practices within the team.
* Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory) with experience building automation frameworks.
* Experience with system-level testing and debugging of distributed systems
* Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, multithreading, and system internals
* Experience in storage technologies, with strong preference for SAN protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF)
* Understanding of file systems, data paths, replication, or high-availability systems
* Experience in test automation for scale, performance, and stress scenarios
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and modern development workflows.
* Strong debugging skills across software and system layers.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8-12 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of owning and delivering quality outcomes for complex subsystems
* Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately to highly complex problems and drive solutions Preferred Qualifications
* Deep expertise in SAN/block storage domain (ONTAP, SnapMirror, SVM, HA/MetroCluster, etc.)
* Experience in large-scale system validation and customer scenario testing
* Exposure to cloud-integrated storage or hybrid cloud architectures
* Prior experience in SDET roles driving automation strategy at team level

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**

title: Scrum Master 3 - India
description:
**Description**
As part of our Google Cloud Transformation, we have started to adopt a product operating model to bring the business and technology closer together, enabling us to work in a more agile and collaborative way. At a high level, we are forming cross-functional product teams that bring together individuals with complementary skill sets to own all aspects of these products from vision, roadmaps, design, development, testing and operation, helping to drive greater alignment and shared ownership in the process.
  
  
The Scrum Master is a Pod (Product oriented design) member responsible for guiding the team in Agile best practices, helping to remove impediments, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement, continuous flow of value, and consistent quality. Duties include: implementing product management/best practices, introducing agile engineering practices, coaching team members, hosting scrum and PI ceremonies/events, assisting product owners with backlog and roadmap management, removing roadblocks, creating transparency, supporting governance and reporting, resolving conflicts, promoting a lean-agile mindset and exhibiting leadership behavior by safeguarding adoption of Scrum practices and principles
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Collaborates with the Product Owner to coordinate product delivery and ensures the sprint goals are clear and accepted by the delivery team
* Facilitates Scrum/PI ceremonies focusing on impediment removal; facilitates feedback on solution and backlog improvement
* Assists Product Owner with review of team backlog and prepares for upcoming sprints
* Monitors progress, issues and risks; tracks and socializes delivery metrics
* Helps align the team on PI plan and objectives and identifies risks and issues

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Ability to remove barriers and keep the team on track, share experiences and encourage collaboration
* Experience - 5 - 8 Years
* Knowledge of engineering best practices
* Good communication/listening skills
* Ability to coach for team development
* Flexibility and persistence
* Conflict resolution and team building skills
* Strong organization skills with empathy
* Ability to work with and lead a team
* Self-motivated with an ability to stay focused in the midst of distraction
* At least 8 years related experience as a project team member and a minimum of 3 years' experience in Agile software development including coaching on agile methodologies, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Experience with successful Agile techniques
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline

CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.

title: AI Project Specialist
description:

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
As part of Alstom’s global digital transformation, our Data Science & AI team plays a strategic role in accelerating innovation, operational excellence, and enterprise‑wide adoption of AI‑driven solutions.
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your
**Project Management**
skills in the exciting cutting-edge field of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring effective delivery of enterprise grade digital and AI‑enabled initiatives to support operational excellence at Alstom.
  
  
Day‑to‑day, you’ll collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to shape AI use cases end‑to‑end — from problem framing and feasibility, through requirements and backlog refinement, to planning and tracking project activities, managing timelines and milestones, and supporting coordination across business, PMO, and delivery teams. You’ll contribute to solution design discussions, assist in backlog refinement, and help ensure smooth execution and adoption of digital initiatives.
  
  
**We’ll look to you for:**

* Translating business needs into clear, functional and non‑functional specifications and high‑quality documentation
* Scoping AI use cases with stakeholders and defining success metrics/KPIs and acceptance criteria
* Supporting project planning, scheduling, milestone tracking and dependency management
* Managing end-to-end project from identifying Make vs Buy, RFP launching & processing and lead the project
* Organising discovery workshops and design thinking sessions to identify, prioritise and refine AI opportunities
* Conducting stakeholder analysis, gap and impact assessments, and maintaining traceability across requirements
* Collaborating with Data Scientists and Data Engineers, Architects, development teams and PMO to ensure alignment
* Ensure alignment on feasibility, requirements, dependencies and delivery constraints across teams
* Managing product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) and supporting Agile ceremonies in Jira/Azure DevOps/Confluence
* Preparing project artefacts (RAID logs, dashboards, status reports, documentation)
* Coordinating with cross‑functional teams to track deliverables and resolve issues. Driving UAT planning, test coordination, defect management, training and adoption activities
* Identifying and tracking risks across scope, timelines, resources, governance and compliance.
* Supporting change management activities: communication, training coordination, onboarding and post‑deployment follow‑up
* Demonstrating curiosity, resilience, and a continuous‑learning mindset to evaluate new tools while ensuring value delivery
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms like Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku and LibreChat to support development of AI prototypes/PoCs will be a plus

**All About You**
We value curiosity, ownership and a growth mindset. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, or equivalent with technical exposure
* 5–10 years experience as a Project Manager, Business Analyst or similar role in enterprise‑scale initiatives
* Proven experience in requirements engineering (BRD/FRD, user stories, process modelling such as BPMN/UML, prioritization techniques, acceptance criteria)
* Experience planning and coordinating multi‑stakeholder projects, including RAID and project dashboards
* Proficiency with BA/PM tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, Excel and PowerPoint
* Strong communication and facilitation skills to interact with business and technical teams and translate complex AI/technical topics for non‑technical audiences
* Good understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall project delivery frameworks
* Experience supporting UAT, change management and user training for digital solutions
* Familiarity with data analytics and reporting tools like Power BI and Qlik Sense
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and lifecycle (use‑case framing, data pipelines, evaluation metrics, model limitations) is expected.
* Good To have:

+ Experience with agentic AI platforms (e.g., Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku, LibreChat) and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
+ Technical foundations (good to have): basic SQL, understanding of APIs/integrations, data structures and data quality concepts;
+ Certifications (good to have): PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CBAP, PMI‑PBA

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues across a global enterprise
* Contribute to innovative AI programmes and work with cutting‑edge platforms to deliver solutions for business needs across Alstom
* Utilise a dynamic, learning‑oriented environment that fosters adaptability and technical curiosity
* Shape and influence digital delivery, stakeholder engagement and governance, with clear progression paths in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation and Data & AI careers

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our Customer Operations team. You’ll be joining a people-focused company, and as a Senior Quality Engineer and will be the functional lead between the product release and the customer's business. You own the test scope for each customer upgrade, resolve gaps between the new release and how the customer works today, and lead customer walkthroughs of what changed. You collaborate with Professional Services, Support and Product team.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

* Own the scope of test cases for customer upgrade and update projects, based on the release's delta features and the customer's configuration and customizations.
* Identify and resolve business gaps introduced by a release. Document each gap, agree on a fix or workaround with Product and Engineering, and track it to closure.
* Lead walkthroughs and demos of delta features for customer teams, and answer functional questions during UAT.
* Produce delta-feature decks and recordings, and keep them in the customer's shared site.
* Triage issues raised in testing, such as failed jobs, calculation mismatches and access problems. Write clear tickets with steps to reproduce, and follow them to resolution.
* Judge go-live readiness: test coverage, sign-off criteria and cutover steps. Flag timeline risks early to the customer and to leadership.
* Present status and risks in the weekly customer touchpoints, and act as the escalation point for functional issues.
* Mentor analysts and run structured knowledge transfers when team members change.

**THE SKILL SET**

* 5 to 8 years as a business or functional analyst on enterprise software, ideally SaaS, pricing, or rebate and contract management.
* Proven record of leading UAT and customer upgrades from test planning through go-live.
* Deep understanding of finance workflows such as invoicing, rebates, chargebacks and payments.
* Comfortable with Jira and ticket-based support processes.
* Strong presentation skills with both technical and business audiences, including senior customer stakeholders.
* Clear written communication, and the ability to work across time zones.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Model N or similar life sciences and high-tech revenue management products.
* Familiarity with ERP integrations such as Oracle.
* Prior experience mentoring or leading a small team.

* Professional growth and Development opportunities.
* Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
* Flexible working hours
* 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday

* Competitive pay and bonus
* 18 vacation days in a year in addition to 15 days Sick Leave/ Casual leave per calendar year.
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time off per year
* 26 weeks of paid maternity leave and 10 days of paid paternity leave.
* 12 wellness leaves for women employees
* Health Insurance of up to 7 lacs for self, spouse, 4 dependent children, and parents. 100% of the premium is paid by Vendavo and it covers the employee, spouse, children, and their parents.
* Group Term Insurance coverage up to three times of their Annual CTC . Dependents are not covered.
* Group Personal Accident coverage up to three times of Annual CTC. Dependents are not covered.
* Provident fund contributions

**THE VENDAVO STORY**
Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people.
  
  
**OUR SAAS PRODUCTS**
Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager). You can learn more about our products here .
  
  
**OUR FUNDING**
We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE & YOU**

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Corporate Functions
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
CGA & Corporate Secretariat Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Corporate Government Affairs and the Corporate Secretariat. This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Corporate Functions Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Corporate Functions Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the products supported.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner & partner with the business to realise product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional, technical specifications needed to deliver new product, changes and support configuration or code delivery.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and implement AI, automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Business knowledge in a relevant functional domain & familiarity with associated technology platforms that enable them (e.g., IT, Internal & External Communications, Corporate Secretariat), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g.Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Kanban, Agile Methodology, Business Analysis, Corporate Secretarial Work, Documentations, Product Lifecycle, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Requirements Gathering, Scrum (Agile), Sprint Planning, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, and scale cloud-native applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS technologies, and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate is a well-rounded full-stack engineer who works independently across backend services, modern web application development, and cloud-native architectures, applying sound engineering judgment across a range of situations with only occasional guidance. The role requires familiarity with AI-assisted development practices and the ability to incorporate AI-powered capabilities into business solutions where they add measurable value. This individual demonstrates strong ownership, delivers quality outcomes with minimal oversight, contributes to design and architecture based on approved patterns, and supports and mentors less-experienced engineers while contributing hands-on to the design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications using AWS services and modern engineering practices.
* Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and contemporary frontend development practices.
* Build responsive, performant, and user-friendly experiences in partnership with product owners and business stakeholders.
* Develop scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices-based architectures, ensuring optimal use of frameworks for efficient, maintainable code.
* Contribute across the full technology stack, from user interfaces through APIs, business services, cloud infrastructure, and production support.
* Draft designs and architecture based on approved patterns, and apply best practices for cloud architecture, security, observability, performance, and resiliency.
* Design AWS serverless components (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) and containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and proactively identify cost-optimization opportunities.
* Optimize database design and queries across relational (Postgres, Aurora, MySQL, Oracle) and non-relational (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) stores, and contribute to data modeling activities.
* Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications, and create and maintain operational dashboards in CloudWatch, Sumo Logic, and Dynatracz.
* Lead RFCs and support deployments; create effective root-cause analyses for incidents to prevent recurrence.
* Resolve security defects raised by AMU, Veracode, SCA, and Wiz scans independently, embracing a security-first mindset.
* Utilize Delta-approved AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Kiro) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, while critically validating AI-generated output.
* Evaluate and incorporate AI-powered capabilities into applications when they provide measurable business value.
* Demonstrate end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from design through production support, delivering with minimal supervision.
* Proactively identify risks and dependencies, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and mentor developers through code reviews and pair programming.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 4-7 years of software development experience with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Strong understanding in developing enterprise web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend development patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems, including the ability to draft architecture based on approved patterns.
* Experience or strong understanding of Event Driven or Kafka.
* Experience deploying and managing applications using ROSA, Kubernetes, and Docker.
* Solid working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitLab CI, ROSA pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, Nexus, SonarQube, Veracode).
* Strong programming skills in Java; working knowledge of Python is a plus.
* Experience optimizing SQL/NoSQL databases, writing efficient queries, and contributing to data modeling.
* Demonstrated experience using Delta-approved AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated outputs.
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt design, and common AI-assisted development practices.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical solutions independently with occasional guidance.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior developers and reviewing peers' pull requests.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* This role requires participation in shared on-call support rotation, including holidays and weekends. In the event of a production emergency, the individual must be available to provide 24/7 support.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification.
* Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing.
* Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments.
* Exposure to modern AI technologies and frameworks, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP, is a plus.

title: Specialist
description: Role OverviewWe are looking for a hands-on Test Specialist to own the testing of assigned product areas end-to-end and to bring an AI-first way of working into every part of the QA lifecycle. We expect the person to actively apply AI across requirement analysis, test case generation, test data creation, defect triage, and reporting — in line with our Innovate for Growth 2027 mandate.Key Responsibilities Product Area Ownership & Sprint Testing Own end-to-end testing of assigned product areas across the sprint lifecycle — from grooming to sign-off. Design and execute test cases (with AI assistance wherever it accelerates the work), maintain them in QMetry, and drive defects through to closure in Jira. Ensure adequate coverage of functional, integration, and regression scenarios within sprint timelines. Convert requirements into testable scenarios using AI-driven tooling as a first pass, then refine with domain judgement. title: Engineering Manager
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We're here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We're revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day's work.
  
  
The Forms team builds one of the most widely used features in the Smartsheet ecosystem — the experiences that let our customers easily manage and collect intake from their own customers and internal teams. We're a vibrant team with engineers at every level — from early-career to senior — and we're responsible for making it simple and reliable for anyone to gather structured information at scale. We're deepening our investment in operational excellence and exploring how AI can make intake smarter, and we're looking for an Engineering Manager to help lead the team through this next chapter.
  
  
You will lead and grow a team of engineers spanning all experience levels, coaching them to deliver high-quality, highly available backend systems on time and with lasting technical health. You'll bring strong technical judgment in backend development, architecture, and design to guide the team's decisions, own the roadmap creation and execution for the Forms team, partner closely with Product and cross-functional stakeholders, and help raise the bar on operational excellence for a feature that's critical to the Smartsheet experience.
  
  
**You Will**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers across all experience levels, building a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Own roadmap creation and prioritization for the Forms team in partnership with Product and Design, translating customer and business needs into a clear, sequenced plan
* Drive successful, predictable delivery of projects — from scoping through launch — balancing quality, speed, and technical debt
* Provide hands-on technical guidance on backend architecture and design, helping the team make sound long-term decisions for a high-scale, highly used system
* Champion operational excellence, raising the bar on system reliability, availability, and performance, and leading the team's response to incidents and post-incident learning
* Build and evolve team structure, process, and ways of working (e.g., planning cadence, on-call, sprint/Scrumban process) to match team growth and delivery needs
* Partner with engineering and product leadership to explore and shape opportunities to bring AI-powered capabilities to the forms and intake experience
* Interview, hire, and onboard engineers to build a high-performing, diverse team
* Coach, mentor, and develop direct reports, providing career growth planning, regular feedback, and performance management
* Create an inclusive team culture that recognizes individual strengths and supports engagement and development for engineers at every level
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to ensure Forms work is well-integrated with the broader platform
* Communicate roadmap, delivery status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and business leadership
* Other duties as assigned

**You Have**

* Strong technical background in backend development, architecture, and system design; hands-on expertise in Java preferred
* 2-3+ years of experience managing medium-sized engineering teams, with a proven track record of coaching and mentoring engineers across experience levels, from early-career to senior
* A proven track record of successful project delivery, roadmap creation, and team/process building
* Strong experience driving operational excellence — bringing systems up to high standards of reliability, availability, and performance
* Demonstrated ability to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic, growth-oriented environment, with the ability to adapt and shift priorities to meet evolving needs
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical work into business impact for stakeholders at all levels
* Bonus: experience building and leading AI-powered product features

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
  
  
If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

title: Senior Manager - QA & Release
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The QA & Release Senior Manager is responsible for supporting quality assurance practices and coordinating release management activities across the HR Digital & Technology product portfolio. Working across all HR products, the role ensures that changes are tested to a consistent standard, release readiness criteria are met, and releases are coordinated and communicated effectively across product teams and stakeholders. The role supports the delivery of reliable, secure, and compliant changes by embedding quality activities throughout the delivery lifecycle and maintaining visibility of upcoming releases across the portfolio. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and service teams, the QA & Release Senior Manager helps ensure that quality is designed-in from refinement through to post-go-live, while supporting a structured and well-governed release process that protects service stability and business outcomes.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Quality Assurance**

* Support the implementation of QA standards and test approaches across the HR product portfolio, ensuring functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing is carried out consistently across product teams.
* Work with Product Owners and delivery teams to define acceptance criteria, test coverage expectations, and quality gates, ensuring requirements are testable and supported by clear pass/fail criteria.
* Execute and coordinate test activities across product teams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and supporting user acceptance testing, ensuring defects are clearly documented and triaged.
* Apply risk-based testing approaches to prioritise effort across critical services, high-transaction workflows, regulated processes, and cross-product integrations, escalating quality risks to senior stakeholders where required.
* Support the adoption and maintenance of test automation, contributing to automated regression, API testing, and data integrity checks, and ensuring test scripts are maintained and reusable across releases.
* Ensure non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility, operability) are clearly defined and tested prior to release, partnering with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams where required.
* Manage defect lifecycle processes, ensuring issues are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked through to resolution, and that defect trends are analysed to inform continuous improvement.

**Release Management**

* Maintain and coordinate the release calendar across the HR product portfolio, ensuring all product teams have visibility of upcoming releases, dependencies, and sequencing.
* Support release readiness assessments by coordinating release checklists, confirming test completion, gathering signoffs, and ensuring documentation (release notes, runbooks, rollback plans) is complete and accurate prior to deployment.
* Coordinate release communications across product teams, business stakeholders, and Service Operations, ensuring impacted parties are informed of release scope, timing, and any known risks or workarounds.
* Support change control processes, ensuring releases follow required governance and approval workflows and that evidence of testing, risk assessment, and stakeholder sign-off is documented and auditable.
* Support go-live and hypercare activities, monitoring for release-related incidents, coordinating triage across product teams, and ensuring issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner.
* Documents and tracks release outcomes and contribute to post-release reviews, capturing lessons learned, analysing release success rates, and identifying opportunities to improve release processes and reduce release-related incidents.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, Information Technology, Project/Programme Management, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience working in QA, testing, release management, or delivery support roles within technology or digital environments.
* Experience executing and coordinating test activities including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing across one or more platforms or products.
* Experience supporting or coordinating release processes, including release scheduling, readiness assessments, and release communications.
* Familiarity with defect management processes, including logging, triaging, and tracking defects through to resolution.
* Exposure to test automation approaches, including contributing to or maintaining automated regression or API test scripts.
* Awareness of change control, governance, and compliance requirements within enterprise environments.
* Experience working within agile or product-based delivery environments and contributing to iterative planning, testing, and release practices.
* Experience working across multiple teams or workstreams, coordinating testing or release activity to support aligned delivery.
* Professional certifications desirable (e.g., ITSM, etc).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, able to identify, document, and communicate defects and quality risks clearly and accurately.
* Good communication skills, able to coordinate across multiple product teams and communicate release schedules, readiness status, and quality findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Organised and structured in approach, able to manage multiple concurrent testing and release activities, maintain accurate documentation, and track progress across product teams under time pressure.
* Developing analytical skills, able to identify defect trends, assess test coverage, and contribute insights that support continuous improvement in quality and release practices.
* Comfortable working in a matrixed environment, building relationships across product teams and coordinating activity without direct line authority.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change

**Skills**
Knowledge Management, Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), Penetration Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Assurance Analysis, Regression Testing, Release Management, Scripting, Test Automation Framework, Test Case Design, Test Management Tools, Tool Selection, User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
