title: Engineering Leader – Digital Enablement & Lifecycle Services
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Engineering Manager – Digital Enablement & Lifecycle Services

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Engineering NA - CECI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who leads the Digital Enablement pillar — the engineering foundation that powers automation, process transformation, integration services, and lifecycle management across Chubb's technology estate. You will build and lead teams that make digital transformation real: replacing manual processes with intelligent, automated workflows; enabling seamless service integration across complex systems; and ensuring the engineering delivery lifecycle is fast, reliable, and AI-augmented. Candidates from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of engineers building digital enablement platforms, automation services, and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Own the engineering roadmap for process automation, workflow orchestration, and digital transformation programmes within the NA CI estate.
* Drive AI-native engineering across the full SDLC — from requirements parsing and intelligent code generation to automated testing, deployment observability, and agentic automation.
* Deliver scalable integration and automation services connecting core insurance systems, third-party platforms, and digital channels.
* Partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate transformation objectives into engineering outcomes with measurable business impact.
* Embed DevSecOps standards as default practice: CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, infrastructure-as-code, and automated release management.
* Own sprint quality, release cadence, and technical debt trade-offs across the digital enablement portfolio.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI engineering tools — coding assistants, intelligent test generation, agentic workflow frameworks — and embed them into team practice.
* Build and sustain a high-performance engineering team culture: psychological safety, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Hire, onboard, and develop engineering talent; contribute to the Chubb India Digital engineering brand.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong engineering background in Java, .NET, or equivalent enterprise stacks; comfortable reading and reviewing code across the stack.
* Demonstrated experience delivering digital transformation, process automation, or workflow orchestration platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on AI tool adoption: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow tools embedded into team practice — not experimented with.
* Cloud-native development expertise (Azure or AWS): microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, and containerization.
* Experience from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software environments with delivery at meaningful scale.
* 3+ years of engineering leadership experience in agile, high-velocity delivery environments.
* Exposure to integration platforms (MuleSoft, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent) and enterprise automation frameworks is a strong advantage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 18+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams.
* Strong AI-native SDLC practice and digital transformation delivery track record.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India's journey.

**Apply Now**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**ABOUT MiQ**
We’re MiQ, a programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. We connect data from multiple sources to do interesting, exciting, business-problem-solving things for our clients. We’re experts in data science, analytics and programmatic trading, and our people are always ready to solve challenges quickly, and ensure our clients always spend their media investments on the right things in the right places. We’re one of the most innovative, exciting programmatic companies in the industry. MiQ is a place that puts sustainable business growth at its heart. A place where you’ll get support putting your best ideas into practice. A place where you can feel secure, where you can learn and be challenged, and where you can succeed whoever you are, wherever you’re from and whatever makes you different.
  
  
We’re growing at a fast pace and are looking for people who are smart, free-thinking, curious and excited about working in a diverse global culture to do great work and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**WHO YOU ARE**
We love different personalities at MiQ and strive to build teams constructed with diverse backgrounds and inclusive points of view. That said, we firmly believe that our values bring us together and we look for people who align with our values below.
  
  

* Passion – We love and live what we do
* Determination – We always find a way to ‘figure it out’
* Unity – We hold each other accountable. We win and lose as a team
* Agility – We anticipate the unexpected, embrace and adapt to change
* Courage – We dare to think unconventionally

**THE ROLE:**
MiQ is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the development teams that build its proprietary trading platform which powers the end to end advertisement campaign lifecycle for MiQ’s clients. Also lead the development and roll out of the next generation of this platform designed for the business to scale for billion dollar operations.
  
  
Balance exceptional delivery for customers on what matters, engaging team and colleagues, with the needs of the business.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to architect, design and develop end to end software products and systems from the ground up and have ownership of them. You will have the opportunity to utilize a variety of latest Web application frameworks and Big Data technologies. You will be leading Agile teams that utilizes the latest in CI/CD pipelines to speed up the products’ time to market.
  
  
Your key stakeholders would include the Product leads of various products, leads of various teams (traders, business analysts, data scientists). You will be supported by your peers and experts across many fields who will help you succeed. You will be the expert and often the first layer of management of people or projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead high performance technology teams.
* Lead from the front and lead by example
* Hire & develop talented leads & engineers.
* Own and drive business features into technology requirements.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Customers to align technology choices with business requirements.
* Ensure high quality and timely release & support of products
* Actively drive and contribute to architecture and design of products and APIs
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and apply them
* Be a catalyst and drive continuous improvement of engineering practices and improve engineering efficiency.
* Assist the team on design, code reviews and troubleshooting
* Evangelist for high quality products and driver of best practices

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years’ experience bringing innovative products to the market.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering is a must
* Experience building multi-tier web applications, experience working on all layers of the stack is a plus
* Excellent understanding of Object-Oriented Design & Design Patterns
* Excellent grasp of one or more languages including an OO language.
* Experience with cloud technologies, SaaS, PaaS & IaaS.
* Good understanding of NoSQL technologies and Distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Prior experience with Microservices based architectures is a must.
* Internalized and practices agile best practices.
* Leadership skills to build high performance teams & continuously raise the bar on innovation, quality and efficiency.
* Eagerness to mentor the team and be a go-to technology leader.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Innovative in terms of product, technology and processes
* Stay up to date with the latest technologies
* Participate in formulation of the technical roadmap and strategy.
* Collaborates with both internal and external stakeholders and leads cross-functional teams in the development of the roadmap.
* Good communication and presentation skills

At MiQ, we don’t just accept the differences of our people, it is what builds us as a community. MiQ is very proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: Staff Manager/Architect - Automotive, AI Assisted Testing, Automated Testing
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
You are an expert in both software test engineering and AI‑enabled test architecture, with more than ten years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling advanced testing solutions. As part of this role, you will regularly visit Harman premises to collaborate directly with engineering and product teams. Leveraging your deep expertise in AI‑driven validation, automation frameworks, and large‑scale test architectures, you will guide software engineering teams in adopting modern, intelligent testing practices. You will play a central role in enabling AI‑based testing across the entire Intelligent Cockpit division, ensuring higher efficiency, improved coverage, and faster time to market.
  
  
Your technical leadership and ability to translate complex challenges into actionable solutions make you a key contributor to the success of Harman’s customer programs and a strategic asset for the Intelligent Cockpit organization.
  
  
**Your Team:**
You will lead a small testing team, plan their tasks, and bring them to closure.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Architect the test systems, validation strategy, and overall quality framework for the Intelligent Cockpit division.
* Provide technical leadership for the development of the testing framework used to design test cases and support automation across the product line.
* Collaborate closely with engineering leaders, architects, and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment, technical coherence, and shared quality objectives.
* Proactively gather technical input from software engineering teams and drive the definition, evolution, and continuous improvement of software testing solutions.
* Design and implement automation, AI‑enabled validation, and DevOps solutions for the Software Product division.
* Support managers by clarifying technical issues related to software development, testability, integration, and system behavior.
* Communicate complex technical challenges in a clear, structured, and actionable manner to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Advocate for and promote the adoption of a common software testing framework across teams to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on test architecture, automation strategy, and AI‑driven testing solutions, enabling scalable and future‑proof validation capabilities.
* As a senior Test Lead you will be responsible for translating business and system requirements (related mainly to Test, AI and process) into end-to-end technical solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with organizational standards.
* Test architect for future SDV solutions and entire Software product.
* You will ensure an efficient integration of cloud-based testing into the CICD pipeline in order to reduce the overall development lead time (commit to releasable software)
* You will focus to move majority testing of cockpit automotive software to cloud and automate it.
* In this role you will enable unique AI driven test solutions that will help accelerate testing and hence a quicker time to market. Today's biggest challenge is integration testing, which is primarily done on HW and causes major delays in the projects.
* Customers are also interested to see how Harman Intelligent cockpit is doing validation and would want to buy these solutions. You will architect a highly scalable and efficient testing solution for Software Products/Intelligent Cockpit.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent; BE with MBA would be preferred.
* 15+ years of overall software validation experience
* 10+ years of experience as a technical leader in a QA or software automotive testing organization.
* 5+ years of experience in AI‑enabled testing and intelligent automation.
* Fluent English proficiency, both written and spoken.
* Expertise in AI‑enabled testing engineering, including model‑based and data‑driven validation approaches.
* Strong knowledge of testing frameworks, including Android and Linux test frameworks.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical issues to management and cross‑functional audiences.
* Ability to understand, analyze, and capture requirements from multiple engineering teams.
* Deep knowledge of existing software testing solutions within QA organizations.
* Strong understanding of test framework internals and hands‑on experience with Python, C++ development.
* Solid understanding of automotive software development methodologies, including Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262.
* Good understanding of Android architecture and its implications for testing and integration.
* At least 5-year experience in validating web-based SaaS applications.
* At least 5-year experience in validating automotive infotainment software.
* Experience in automating a test suite for web-based SaaS applications.
* Experience in automating a test suite for automotive infotainment software.
* Experience working with AWS public cloud.
* Experience in driving the test architecture starting from requirements to deployment.
* Exposure in Google Compliance Testing (CTS, VTS, STS, ACTS etc)
* Familiar with CDD , GAS and related test suites (like the Compatibility Test Suite)
* In-Depth understanding of -Requirement analysis - Test Case Creation - Test Case Execution - Sanity Test.
* Good understanding of development project cycle
* Good understanding of Continuous integration and deployment
* Good understanding of test Driven Development practices.
* Ability to solve the problem independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and awareness of DevOps and Agile principles.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Testing knowledge of overall vehicle testing, that includes other domains like vehicle, chasis, powertrain, ADAS etc.
* Testing with Digital twin on cloud.
* Good experience in creating and generating testing data for testing scenarios that requires huge amount of data (like certain use cases of Autonomous driving)
* QNX experience is a bonus.
* Experience in developing Android middleware and applications
* Knowledge in embedded software engineering
* Experience in testing SaaS cloud solutions

**Things To Know**

* This role is based in Bengaluru and follows a hybrid schedule, with regular in-office collaboration alongside engineering, product, and customer program teams.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

**About ETPL**

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
At Index Exchange, we’re reinventing how digital advertising works—at scale. As a global advertising supply-side platform, we empower the world’s leading media owners and marketers to thrive in a programmatic, privacy-first ecosystem.
  
We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. Our proprietary tech is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in keeping the internet open, accessible, and largely free.
  
We process more than 550 billion real-time auctions every day (in comparison, Google processes 8.5 billion searches per day) with ultra-low latency. Our platform is vertically integrated from servers to networks and runs primarily on our own metal and cloud infrastructure. This end-to-end infrastructure is designed to provide both stability and agility, enabling us to adapt quickly as the market evolves.
  
At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to serve as a technical leader and quality champion across Index. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad cross-team and cross-divisional influence where you will define and drive modern quality engineering practices, build scalable automation, tools, test infrastructure, and enable teams to deliver high-quality, high-performance software with confidence.
  
You will operate at the intersection of architecture, quality, developer experience, and operations, ensuring quality is built into every stage of the software lifecycle. You will also leverage AI to improve testing efficiency and insights.
  
As a SDET champion on the engineering team, you will own the vision for test infrastructures, build frameworks that allow developers to easily write reliable tests, and invent new mechanisms for ensuring that every change we make can be deployed safely and quickly. You will help solve our most difficult challenges and will coach other engineers to foster a culture of relentless high standards.
  
This position reports directly to Senior Engineering Manager based in Bangalore and will work closely with members of the Quality and Delivery teams.
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering/SDET role with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in programming languages such as Golang, Java or C#.
* Proven experience building scalable, reusable, enterprise grade test frameworks, tools and infrastructure for large-scale distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitLab preferred), Containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Experience with microservices architectures, APIs, and data-intensive systems, validating large datasets and pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test strategies, methodologies, and automation at scale.
* Have systems thinking and end-to-end accountability, proactively identifying risks and influencing cross-team quality without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical skills and structured problem-solving to drive clarity and outcomes in ambiguous environments.
* A technical role model, guiding engineers and consistently raising the bar through design, reviews, and best practices.
* Proven ability to lead cross-team initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive engineering excellence at scale
* Demonstrates a learn-and-be-curious mindset, with a strong bias for ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Here’s What You’ll Be Doing**
**Technical Leadership & Quality Strategy**

* Working on cutting edge programmatic ad tech that touches millions of users every single day.
* Collaborate with the Manager to define and evolve the quality engineering vision and strategy for Index’s high-scale distributed systems.
* Drive shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles, influencing system architecture for testability and reliability.
* Establish best practices across functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing.
* Assess current practices, tooling, and workflows to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans that balance impact, feasibility, and organizational readiness.
* Bring clarity to complexity, probing assumptions, identifying quality risks, evaluating trade-offs, and optimization opportunities.

**Test Frameworks, Tooling & Infrastructure**

* Design and build scalable, reusable automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
* Develop tools that enable teams to independently own, measure, and continuously improve quality.
* Enhance and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) to ensure fast, safe, and reliable releases.
* Enable data validation, observability-driven testing, and production validation strategies.

**Cross-Team Influence & Developer Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by enforcing quality standards and best practices.
* Influence design and architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and testability.
* Identify systemic gaps and drive across engineering improvements in testing practices and tooling.
* Standardize quality metrics, reporting, and release quality gates across teams
* Drive improvements in production quality, incident reduction, and system resilience

**Mentorship, Coaching & Hiring**

* Mentor and coach engineers on test design, automation, tooling and quality best practices.
* Raise engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* Actively participate in hiring and bar-raising activities.
* Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and high engineering standards.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Comprehensive health plans for you and your dependents .
* Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules
* Competitive retirement matching plans
* Equity packages
* Company contribution to Provident Fund
* Monthly internet stipend
* Generous parental leave available to birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive parents
* Annual well-being allowance plus fitness discounts and group wellness activities
* Employee assistance program
* Mental health first aid program that provides an in-the-moment point of contact and reassurance
* One day of volunteer time off per year and a donation-matching program
* Monthly town halls and regular community-led team events
* Multiple resources and programming to support continuous learning
* A workplace that supports a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment – learn more here

At Index Exchange, we believe that successful products are built by teams just as diverse as the audience who uses them. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunities. We celebrate diversity of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Additionally, we realize that diversity is deeper than any status or classification—diversity is the human experience. For those who show grit, passion, and humility—Index will welcome you.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology—enabling faster, better, connected insights. Konovo is backed by Frazier Healthcare, a healthcare-only growth private equity firm committed to supporting the vision and expertise of our executive leadership team.
  
  
Konovo's solutions empower organisations to make data-driven decisions that enhance patient outcomes and streamline healthcare processes. We supply healthcare organisations with real-time access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest available anywhere in the world. Our 300+ employees are spread across five countries, collaborating to support some of the largest organisations in the healthcare industry. Our customers include over 300 leading global pharmaceutical, medical device, market research agency, and consultancy companies.
  
  
We are an established but fast-growing business — powered by innovation, data, and technology. Konovo's capabilities are delivered through our cloud-based platform, enabling customers to collect data from healthcare professionals and transform it into actionable insights using cutting-edge AI combined with proven market research tools and techniques.
  
  
As we continue to grow we are expanding our Bengaluru, India engineering team. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to serve as the technical right hand to our Senior Director of Engineering, driving the day-to-day delivery of cutting-edge solutions that power Konovo's platform.
  
  
AI is embedded in our product and internal tooling. You and your team will help us deepen, scale, and operationalise those capabilities across our platform, data systems, and engineering workflows with production reliability and enterprise discipline. This role is for someone who is very strong technically but solution-oriented rather than a pure technician. As a EM you will bring energy, impact, and a drive to get things done collaboratively with a team operating on a global scale. You will inspire, lead, and mentor the team to make things happen.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Act as the technical right hand to the Senior Director of Engineering — translating strategy into day-to-day execution across the Bengaluru engineering team.
* Apply deep technical expertise hands-on: architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and unblocking engineers on hard problems.
* Manage and mentor a cross-functional group of Software, Quality, and Data Engineers, helping each grow their skills and career.
* Drive agile delivery (Scrum) in close partnership with Product and Design, keeping the team focused on outcomes, not just output.
* Bring energy and a get-things-done mindset — identify blockers, propose solutions, and push initiatives to completion.
* Build and ship new product capabilities, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery timelines.
* Champion engineering best practices — code quality, testing, CI/CD, monitoring — raising the bar across the team.
* Partner with global engineering leadership and peers in other regions to align local execution with company-wide standards.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, integrity, and ownership within the team.
* Evangelize and accelerate AI adoption within both engineering practices and our product.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5+ years managing and growing a team of software and/or multi-discipline engineers as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead.
* Very strong technically — credible in architecture and design discussions with a solutions-orientation.
* A bias toward action: energetic, collaborative, and relentless about getting things done.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across a global, distributed organisation.
* Self-starter who can think strategically, creatively, and analytically, and is comfortable operating with ambiguity.
* Passion for learning new technologies and solving complex problems with innovative methods.

**Demonstrated expertise in:**

* Agile methodology and tools, applied hands-on in a team environment.
* Software architecture and design, applied to complex real-world systems.
* Software craftsmanship, SDLC, CI/CD, quality, and monitoring.
* Scaling and growing engineering teams.
* Cloud technology and tooling — comfort with AWS.
* Supporting business-critical systems and products in a SaaS environment.
* Working with and managing global, distributed teams.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science (or equivalent).

**Tech Stack — Direct Experience or Willingness to Quickly Learn**

* Back end: Scala, Java, NodeJS, Go.
* Front end: JavaScript, React, Next.js.
* Database: Databricks, SQL, NoSQL (MongoDB/DocumentDB).
* AI/ML: ML/AI capabilities, Claude Code, AI SDLC, and related concepts.

**Why Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform — so insights aren't just collected, they're connected.
* Work with a team of smart, nice people who get things done.
* Be the technical right hand to a growing engineering leadership team at a critical global hub undergoing transformative growth and innovation.
* Join a fast-growing global team with real opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment designed for employee well-being, growth, and balance.
* Access long-term incentives and comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy.
* Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.

If you're eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you're smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Apply now to be a part of our journey.**

It ensures that product requirements are translated into testable scenarios and that products are accurate, consistent, aligned to design standards and operationally stable.

title: LEAD-Customer Delivery
description:
**About Zinier**
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a Lead, Customer Delivery to lead the successful delivery of complex implementation projects related to deployment of field service and asset management solutions. This role is critical in ensuring our customers achieve measurable business outcomes from our solutions. You will be responsible for driving projects from kickoff through go-live, liaising with cross functional teams, and ensuring scope, schedule, quality, and most importantly customer satisfaction targets are met.
  
  
If you are passionate about solving customer problems, savvy about dealing with multiple stakeholders on both customer and internal sides, and detail oriented enough to be hands-on while driving these complex technical projects, come talk to us.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Facilitate efficient & successful project definition, discovery, design, planning, execution and smooth launch in leading high-performance project teams.
* Manage projects within scope, quality, time, and cost constraints, and ensure any changes are documented and approved through a change control process.
* Build and maintain release and project plans, managing schedules, dependencies, risks, and mitigations, across cross-functional teams, both internal and external.
* Track and report on project milestones and provide regular status reports to all stakeholders, highlighting risks and ensuring agreement and alignment is gained across teams.
* Form strong project team relationships by leading, coaching, and motivating team members, and identifying and resolving blockers or conflicts.
* Enhance delivery excellence by analyzing existing processes, eliminating inefficiencies, and leveraging tools, technology, and intelligent automation to implement scalable frameworks. Champion best practices, metrics, and high-quality standards across delivery programs.
* Coach and mentor teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree; PMI certification a plus
* 9+ years experience in software professional services technical project management
* In-depth knowledge and experience implementing Enterprise software applications
* Experience with client services, project management, and solution delivery in both Waterfall and Agile environments;
* Proven ability to deliver results in fast-paced, ambiguous environments through strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and leadership skills.
* Excellent verbal, presentation, and written communication skills including creating usable documentation and tools.
* Proven ability to present technical solutions effectively to diverse stakeholder groups and to engage effectively with senior executives of large enterprises on both technical and business topics.
* Experience working with a cross-functional and geographically dispersed team and customer base with travel up to 10% of the time (including possible international travel).
* Drive technical discussions across architecture, integrations, APIs, data, environments, security, and platform dependencies.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture and Customer technical teams to translate business requirements into executable technical plans.
* Understand system dependencies and technical risks well enough to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and drive resolution.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation and data-driven insights to improve project execution, predict risks, reduce manual processes and improve delivery efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence , standard PM tools and templates.

title: Staff Software Infrastructure Test Architect
description:
**About us:**

  

Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.

  
  

**Role Overview:**

  

You will drive the architecture and development of software infrastructure used for testing LiDAR firmware, perception software and associated artifacts. You will also drive strategic technology management and future software solutions architecture that meets automotive compliance requirements.

**What you'll do**
  

  
* Architect, design, and develop a robust and scalable Python based test automation framework for performing fully automated tests for embedded devices and providing traceable matrix for requirements to test-case to defect tracking. Develop automation features that allow end-to-end test coverage for all software and system components
  
* Mentor a team of skilled engineers dedicated to developing test cases, following standard coding practices. Drive code reviews to ensure consistent coding standards across all team members
  
* Develop, implement, and optimize test strategies and plans for automotive software, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing
  
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Firmware, digital signal processing algorithms, and Quality Assurance) to define test requirements and review product specifications
  
* Collaborating with the product owners, architects and other stakeholders to understand the business requirements and plan the quality assurance strategies accordingly
  
  

  
**What you'll have**
  

  
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
  
* 8 - 12 years of experience in software testing of embedded devices, preferably in the automotive industry
  
* Expert proficiency in Python and C++ programming and relevant libraries/frameworks for test automation
  
* Prior experience architecting test frameworks
  
* Proficiency in test-case development with docker/Kubernetes
  
* Practical knowledge of verification and validation means using testbeds and simulators as well as experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) and software in the loop (SIL) test environments
  
* Knowledge of Embedded device testing, REST APIs, UI testing, Selenium/Playwright, Embedded Linux, Docker, SSH, Shell scripting, Linux services, Computer networks
  
* Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices using Jenkins, Jira, Bitbucket, Agile methodologies, following sprint cycle for test-case development, system and integration testing
  
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and break down into simple sprint stories
  
* You have a problem-solving mindset and, able to mentor and guide juniors in solving daily development challenges
  
* Proven ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
  
  

  
**What's in it for you**
  

  
* Knowledge of automotive testing standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE, etc
  
* Understanding of automotive software systems, including embedded systems, ADAS, infotainment, or electric vehicle control software
  
* Experience with JAMA for requirements management software (or equivalent)
  
* Experience with JIRA for defect tracking and familiar with Agile methodologies

title: Business Lead, Digital Product Management
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.
* Review and coach analysts on developing structured recommendations and business cases that support informed decision-making and investment prioritization.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.
* Support adherence to product management frameworks, governance processes, and ways of working to ensure consistency across products and teams.
* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Review and coach analysts on defining measurable product outcomes, KPIs, adoption metrics, and value measures, including relevant measures for AI-enabled capabilities such as reliability, output quality, user trust, exception rates, and productivity improvement.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement, using AI-assisted analysis to detect patterns, adoption barriers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.
* Recommend whether products or capabilities should be enhanced, scaled, consolidated, or retired based on value, performance, adoption, risks, and strategic fit.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a key connection point between SCE Product Managers and Business Analyst using AI-assisted synthesis to improve shared understanding of needs, decisions, requirements, and delivery implications.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives, using AI to organize inputs, compare options, clarify areas of agreement, conflict, and unresolved risks.
* Facilitate decisions on requirements, priorities, scope, trade-offs, and delivery, using AI-supported analysis to present options and implications while ensuring accountable stakeholders make final decisions.
* Communicate product roadmaps, progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership, using approved AI tools to accelerate concise, audience-appropriate updates that are reviewed for accuracy and context.
* Translate technical and AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs into clear business language, and translate business needs into actionable direction for technology teams.

People Management & Team Development
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of business analysts, product professionals, and related roles, including building their ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve work quality, speed, and business impact.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations, including expectations for appropriate AI use, verification of outputs, data protection, and accountability for final work products.
* Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development, using AI-assisted preparation where appropriate while retaining personal judgment and accountability for employee decisions.
* Allocate work and resources based on priorities, capacity, skills, and development opportunities, using AI-supported workload and scenario analysis to inform—not determine—management decisions.
* Mentor team members in business analysis, product management, stakeholder engagement, Agile ways of working, and responsible application of AI to research, synthesis, requirements, testing, and communication.
* Establish consistent standards and best practices for requirements, product documentation, prioritization, delivery, and AI-assisted ways of working, including validation, traceability, privacy, security, and governance expectations.
* Identify capability gaps and create development plans to strengthen team effectiveness, including AI literacy, prompt and context design, critical evaluation of outputs, data fluency, and value measurement.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture that encourages responsible experimentation, shared learning, and scaling of proven AI-enabled practices.

**Other Duties**
Cultivate and Sustain Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to build trust, open communication, and shared ownership of project goals.
  
  

* Champion J&J Values: Model J&J C.E.O. Leadership Behaviors and values to reinforce a healthy and motivating workplace culture.
* Support Team Cohesion: Plan and participate in team-building activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and feedback loops that foster trust, collaboration, and team cohesion.
* Encourage Growth: Support mentorship, and continuous learning within the team.

**Required Minimum Education**
: Bachelor’s Degree (with 7+ years of experience) and/or Master’s Degree (with 5+ years of experience)
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or Supply Chain.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines in highly regulated business environments.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, performance management, prioritization, and employee development.
* Digital acumen and strong business analysis experience, including process analysis, requirements definition, future-state design, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience managing digital products or technology-enabled capabilities through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing requirements/user stories, and prioritizing features.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business, engineering, architecture, data, and other technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Accountability, Advanced Analytics, Analytical Reasoning, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Requirements Analysis, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Organizing, Problem Solving, Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Systems Development, Technical Credibility, Technical Writing, Workflow Analysis

title: Senior Release Engineer
description:
**Bring more to life.**
At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact, innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.
  
  
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we are committed to hiring and developing from within. You will thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.
  
  
Learn Danaher Business System, which makes everything possible.
  
  
The Senior Release Engineer owns the planning, coordination, governance, and continuous improvement of releases across Danaher's Enterprise Data Platform, including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, Airflow, GitHub, and related data services. This role orchestrates releases across platform, data engineering, operations, security, and OpCo teams, ensuring changes are tested, approved, traceable, communicated, and deployed with minimal business disruption. The Release Manager strengthens release discipline through automation, standard controls, metrics, and pragmatic delivery practices while supporting both planned releases and urgent production changes.
  
  
This position reports to the Director - Data Platform and Operations and is part of the Enterprise Data Engineering team located in the Bangalore IDC office. The specific working arrangement will be confirmed by the interview team.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Lead end-to-end release management and governance for the data platform, including release planning, scope, schedules, dependencies, readiness reviews, go/no-go decisions, change approvals, production readiness checks, deployments, validation, rollback, hypercare, closure activities, and post-release reviews with clear decision tracking and accountability.- Coordinate cross-functional delivery and stakeholder alignment by partnering with platform engineering, data engineering, DataOps, architecture, security, service management, vendors, and OpCo teams to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, represent releases at Change Approval Boards, ensure adherence to DHR standard processes, and align release trains with enterprise platform priorities, data product delivery, compliance commitments, and OpCo onboarding.- Establish and continuously improve release processes, standards, and automation by defining and maintaining release calendars, checklists, entry and exit criteria, deployment and rollback plans, runbooks, evidence requirements, and release reporting, while advancing GitHub Actions, CI/CD, GitOps, automated testing, environment promotion, and deployment controls.- Ensure change, risk, compliance, and production stability management by enforcing change-management, segregation-of-duties, security, audit, compliance, and emergency change requirements; coordinating release windows, production validation, incident handoffs, rollback decisions, and release communications to minimize failed changes and service disruptions.- Drive release transparency, performance measurement, and continuous improvement through stakeholder communications, reporting of release status, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions, and by leveraging release outcomes, defects, incidents, lead time, deployment frequency, rollback trends, and lessons learned to improve delivery reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in release management, change management, platform operations, software delivery, or related technology disciplines, including responsibility for coordinating enterprise production releases across complex technology environments.- Proven experience managing releases across cloud, data, or software platforms, working across multiple teams, environments, dependencies, and stakeholder groups while balancing competing priorities and ensuring successful delivery outcomes.- Strong technical understanding of modern data platform technologies, including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, and Apache Airflow, with the ability to assess deployment dependencies, operational impacts, and production risks.- Hands-on knowledge of modern software delivery and change-control practices, including GitHub Enterprise or comparable source-control platforms, CI/CD methodologies, branching and promotion strategies, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback procedures, and IT service management/change processes using ServiceNow or equivalent tools, including standard, normal, and emergency changes.- Exceptional planning, facilitation, documentation, risk management, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple releases, translate complex technical release information into concise status, readiness, risk, and decision communications for both engineering teams and executive leadership; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and occasionally internationally for team meetings, planning workshops, vendor engagements, and OpCo collaboration.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Release management for regulated or audit-sensitive platforms under SOX, SOC 1/2, GxP, privacy, or similar control frameworks.
* GitOps, reusable GitHub Actions workflows, automated quality gates, artifact versioning, and progressive delivery practices.
* Data platform observability, incident management, problem management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.
* Coordinating releases in a multi-OpCo, multi-tenant, or federated enterprise environment.
* Certifications such as ITIL 4, SAFe, Scrum.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

We are seeking a seasoned Sr. Software Engineer in the WEX Mobility Engineering organization. This role will sit in the North America Mobility team that caters fleet management and mobility payments solutions to our large customers and partners in the North America region. Mobility development team spans across USA, Brazil, and India. Our Mobility systems provide SaaS and API solutions to various customers. WEX Mobility products enable credit issuance to fleet companies and their workers in the form of WEX or cobranded credit cards, usable at fueling stations and select other merchants. At WEX, we provide fleet managers and operators with fuel discounts, and flexibility to configure spend controls that restrict fleet members to use their cards at configured merchants, for configured amounts and velocity.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance object oriented code in our backend services.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to define and implement new features.

**Experience You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a collaborative and empathetic mindset.

* 8 years of experience in software engineering.

* Experience working on card payments

* Familiarity with mobile development (iOS or Android)
* Experience building AI skills & deploying AI solutions to production environments
* Experience building production-grade AI agents or copilots

You will define and drive the application architecture for our platform — designing scalable, resilient systems in .NET and Angular/React — while embedding quality engineering into every architectural decision. You'll champion AI-powered development practices across the entire SDLC, set the technical vision for quality at the architecture level, and mentor engineering teams on building software that is correct by construction, not just tested after the fact. We're looking for someone who sees quality not as a phase but as an architectural property, who leads through technical excellence, and who thrives at the intersection of product engineering, quality engineering, and AI-driven innovation.
  
  
**Required Skills:**

* Education: BE, B. Tech, M. Tech Only
* Experience Level: 10-15+ Years of hands-on software engineering experience, with 4+ years in Leading or staff engineer role

**Mandatory Skills (Full-Stack + Quality & Product Engineering)**

* Deep expertise in .NET framework (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and modern frontend frameworks (Angular 10+ and/or ReactJS with TypeScript).
* Proven experience designing and owning application architectures: service decomposition, API design, data modelling, and system integration patterns.
* Strong proficiency in microservice architecture, event-driven programming, async design patterns, and distributed systems.
* Extensive experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and Web APIs with a focus on contract-first design.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript for building robust, accessible user interfaces.
* Solid experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level quality engineering mindset: deep experience with test automation frameworks, unit/integration/end-to-end testing, contract testing, and performance/load testing at the architecture level.
* Proven ability to embed quality gates in CI/CD pipelines — linting, static analysis, test coverage thresholds, security scanning, and automated regression.
* Strong understanding of quality management principles: defect prevention strategies, root cause analysis, test planning, quality metrics, and continuous quality improvement across the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated expertise using AI-powered development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, AI code-review/test-generation tools) and defining AI SDLC standards for engineering teams.
* Experience with version control systems (Git), branching strategies, and code review practices at scale.
* Strong architecture documentation skills — ADRs, system design documents, sequence diagrams, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Proven ability to mentor and lead engineers across multiple teams; strong track record of raising the technical and quality bar.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own and evolve the application architecture for full-stack systems built on .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular/React, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality by design.
* Design quality-first architectures: embed testability, observability, fault isolation, and graceful degradation as first-class architectural concerns — not afterthoughts.
* Define and drive the AI-first engineering strategy: establish standards for AI-powered development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, AI code-review/test-generation tools) and AI SDLC best practices across engineering teams.
* Design and build microservice-based, event-driven systems with async design patterns, ensuring resilience, loose coupling, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead the quality engineering practice at the architecture level: define test automation strategies, contract testing frameworks, performance/load testing architectures, and shift-left quality gates embedded in CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and architectural decision records (ADRs) that raise the quality bar across all product engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineering leads, QA leadership, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and architectural roadmaps.
* Drive cross-team technical alignment: review system designs, conduct architecture reviews, and ensure consistency across services and modules.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid-level engineers on architecture principles, quality engineering practices, AI tool adoption, and full-stack development excellence.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, AI/ML frameworks, and quality tools to continuously improve engineering velocity, reliability, and product quality.
* Prepare and maintain architectural documentation including system design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement — run blameless postmortems, quality retrospectives, and proactively identify architectural debt and quality risks.
