* Experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) or equivalent cloud platforms (Azure, GCP).
* Experience with containerisation and orchestration tools — Docker & Kubernetes — and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

* Experience with API management platforms such as Apigee and local development workflow tools like Tilt.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, or similar — including defining SLIs, SLOs, and alerting strategies.
* Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks or platforms and their application in software engineering and quality engineering workflows.
* Experience with cloud-native architectural patterns: serverless, service mesh, CQRS, event sourcing.

description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans.
* Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability.
* Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices.
* Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities.
* Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics.
* Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability.
* Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/.NET and related technologies.
* Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments.
* Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration.
* Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates.
* Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems.
* Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases.
* Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks.
* Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry.
* Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation.
* Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems.
* Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule.
* Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring.
* Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums.

**What You'll Bring**

* 12–18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment.
* B.E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering.
* Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems.
* Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction.
* Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability.
* Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards.
* Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk.
* Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence.
* Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities.
* Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation.
* Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software.
* Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.
* C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous.

title: Member Technical Staff II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Lead Developer to lead technical delivery for a team: hands-on coding, architecture alignment, and raising the bar on quality and operations. You will design and ship backend capabilities, partner on requirements and trade-offs, and help the team deliver reliably in production.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and review features and APIs (services, integrations, data access).
* Own reliability for services you touch: correctness, performance, observability, and safe releases.
* Work with the team on architecture for new capabilities and on improving existing systems (database schema, caching, deployment, operational runbooks).
* Partner with product and other engineering teams on requirements, estimates, and technical trade-offs.
* Review code, clarify design, and mentor engineers informally; contribute to a culture of quality and learning.
* Identify and drive process improvements: clearer contracts, better tests, CI/CD hygiene, and reduced operational toil.
* Create and maintain technical documentation where it helps onboarding and operations.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional experience shipping production backend services in Java (e.g. Spring Boot) or an equivalent JVM stack; comfortable with REST APIs, validation, auth integration (e.g. OAuth2 / JWT), and common Spring patterns.
* Data stores — solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (e.g. Flyway or similar), indexing, transactions, and debugging slow queries.
* Caching — hands-on use of Redis or Valkey (or similar): cache keys, TTLs, invalidation, and failure modes when cache is down or stale.
* Build and quality — Gradle or Maven, unit/integration tests, constructive code review habits, and CI-friendly workflows.
* Containers and cloud — Docker; deploying or operating services on AWS (or similar): configs, secrets, logs, metrics.
* Observability — metrics, logs, and tracing sufficient to find regressions and latency issues in production.
* API and integration design — clear contracts, versioning or backward-compatibility discipline, and safe handling of errors and idempotency where it matters.
* Education — Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Version control — strong experience with Git and collaborative branching/review practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Ad tech or high-QPS adjacent — experience with auctions, bidding, strict latency budgets, or very high read/write traffic.
* Rust or other systems languages — for performance-critical services or tooling.
* Kubernetes and GitOps-style deployments.
* UI collaboration — comfort reading, debugging, or occasionally contributing to our web UI built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Material UI (MUI), TanStack Query, React Router, and Tailwind CSS (pairing with UI engineers on API contracts, auth flows, and end-to-end behavior).
* Event-driven design, messaging, or stream processing.
* Infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Prior mentoring, technical leadership, or leading small initiatives.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead day-to-day Data Execution & Operations activities for one or more assigned therapeutic areas, ensuring delivery stability, business continuity, and timely execution.
* Report to and partner closely with the Director of Data Execution & Operations to execute portfolio priorities, operational plans, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary operational contact for assigned therapeutic areas and maintain a detailed understanding of their data sources, business rules, processing frequencies, dependencies, and service expectations.
* Provide hands-on oversight of data processing, production support, incident management, issue triage, release readiness, operational handoffs, and post-release validation.
* Maintain an integrated backlog and demand tracker with clear scope, ownership, priority, status, dependencies, target timelines, and escalation needs.
* Track and report SLAs, operational KPIs, delivery status, incidents, recurring issues, backlog health, demand, risks, and improvement actions.
* Provide the Director and leadership with a clear and transparent view of work in the pipeline, upcoming demand, operational health, capacity needs, and decisions required.
* Lead timely escalation of critical incidents, data delays, delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, and capacity constraints.
* Work directly with teams to investigate issues, perform root cause analysis, coordinate corrective actions, and confirm sustainable resolution.
* Identify and implement automation, monitoring, reconciliation, alerting, and workflow improvements that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Bring forward practical ideas and reusable approaches that strengthen operational quality, efficiency, responsiveness, and stakeholder experience.

Therapeutic Area and Team Leadership
  
  

* Own operational delivery for one or more therapeutic areas and align execution with market, franchise, brand, and launch priorities.
* Coordinate the day-to-day work of ICC team members supporting the assigned therapeutic areas, providing direction, prioritization, coaching, and issue-resolution support.
* Ensure team responsibilities, coverage, handoffs, and escalation paths are clear and consistently followed.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders and develop a practical understanding of therapeutic-area processes, critical data, and downstream impacts.
* Support team development by strengthening technical, domain, operational, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Promote a culture of ownership, responsiveness, transparency, collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.

Operational Governance and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Apply the enterprise operating model within assigned therapeutic areas while accommodating market- and franchise-specific needs.
* Run regular operational reviews covering SLA performance, delivery commitments, incident trends, backlog, demand, risks, dependencies, and improvement progress.
* Ensure operating procedures, runbooks, support documentation, ownership matrices, and escalation protocols remain complete and current.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable visibility into performance, pipeline, recurring issues, capacity, and improvement actions.
* Use operational data, trend analysis, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to prioritize automation and process improvements.
* Ensure operational readiness for product launches, new data sources, platform changes, business-rule changes, and major releases.

Stakeholder and Partner Management
  
  

* Partner with therapeutic-area business leaders, data teams, analytics, architecture, governance, source-system teams, platform teams, and operations stakeholders.
* Translate business needs and priorities into clear operational requirements, work plans, ownership, and service commitments.
* Communicate delivery status, issues, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate vendor and delivery-partner execution for assigned therapeutic areas, including staffing, quality, timelines, service performance, and corrective actions.
* Escalate material risks and decisions to the Director of Data Execution & Operations with clear context, impact, options, and recommended actions.

Pharma and Life Sciences Responsibilities
  
  

* Apply pharmaceutical commercial and oncology data knowledge to operational execution, validation, issue investigation, and continuous improvement.
* Support customer, patient, product, sales, claims, specialty pharmacy, market access, field activity, and syndicated data operations, as applicable to assigned therapeutic areas.
* Ensure sensitive and regulated data is handled with appropriate privacy, security, access, retention, lineage, quality, and audit controls.
* Understand therapeutic-area business rules, data frequencies, critical processes, reporting cycles, and service expectations.
* Coordinate operational readiness and stabilization activities for product launches and changing business priorities.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in data operations, data engineering, data delivery, production support, or related technology disciplines, including team or program leadership responsibility.
* Proven experience managing day-to-day operations and delivery for complex data programs, portfolios, markets, franchises, or therapeutic areas.
* Demonstrated ability to work hands-on with teams to investigate issues, coordinate execution, manage priorities, and drive work through resolution.
* Strong experience with SLAs, KPIs, incident management, backlog and demand management, operational reporting, escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Experience using automation, monitoring, reconciliation, alerting, and observability to improve operational performance and reduce manual effort.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms, Databricks, cloud technologies, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and production-support practices.
* Experience coordinating distributed teams, vendors, stakeholders, dependencies, capacity, and delivery risks.
* Strong pharmaceutical or life sciences domain knowledge, preferably across commercial or oncology data ecosystems.
* Ability to communicate complex operational issues clearly, influence stakeholders, make sound decisions, and drive accountability.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a relevant technical or business discipline.
* Experience working within an India Capability Center or similar global delivery organization.
* Experience with Azure, Databricks, data observability, workflow automation, and enterprise data platforms.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical product launches, syndicated data, specialty pharmacy, patient services, sales, claims, and market access operations.
* Experience in global, matrixed, Agile, product-oriented, and SLA-driven environments.
* Experience developing operational dashboards, service-management reports, and demand or backlog views.

Success in This Role
  
  

* Delivers stable, reliable, and transparent operations across assigned therapeutic areas.
* Provides hands-on leadership and strong day-to-day direction to ICC team members and delivery partners.
* Maintains clear visibility into operational performance, backlog, demand, pipeline, risks, dependencies, and capacity needs.
* Meets service commitments through disciplined execution, measurable SLAs, timely reporting, and effective escalation.
* Reduces manual effort and recurring issues through automation, standardization, and sustainable problem resolution.
* Builds trusted partnerships with the Director of Data Execution & Operations and therapeutic-area stakeholders.

**Benefits:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
  
  

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Programs
* Reimbursements – Home Internet & Mobile Phone
* Employee Referral Program
* Leaves – Paternity Leave (4 Weeks) , Maternity Leave (up to 26 weeks), Bereavement Leave (5 calendar days)

**About ICC in Takeda:**

* Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We’re not just transforming our company; we’re improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day.
* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization

title: Senior-TD&E-FS-Scrum Master(NR)
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Scrum Master- PPM Senior Consultant**
**Opportunity**
Transformation Design & Execution @ EY provides a rewarding career targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology, and infrastructure transformations. If you have a passion for rallying together with a team to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic TD&E team! Our team is looking for a Scrum Master to support the range of clients we serve.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Guide and coach the Scrum Team on how to use Agile practices and principles to deliver high quality products and services to our customers
* Build high performing teams by recognizing areas of strength and improvement and employing appropriate coaching and development techniques
* Responsible for ensuring Scrum is understood and the team adheres to Scrum theory, practice, and guidelines
* Coach the Scrum team in self-organization, cross-functional skillset, domain knowledge and communicate effectively, both internally and externally working within the Scrum team
* Work with Scrum Team, as well as internal and external stakeholders, to influence and drive decision making and support organizational project or product teams
* Resolve team impediments with other Scrum Masters to increase the effectiveness of the application of Scrum in the organization
* Work with Agile coaches and other Scrum Masters to grow within the role and demonstrate Servant leadership skills
* Contribute to the advancement and improvement of Agile practices within the organization
* Facilitate and support all Scrum events: Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective
* Support delivery in large-scale transformation or managed services environments
* Enable collaboration across cross-functional teams, including technology, business, and operations stakeholders in global delivery models

**Education**

* Graduates / BE - B. Tech / MCA

**Certification**

* CSM/ SAFe Agilist / SAFe Scrum Master / PMI-ACP /PSM/ A-CSM

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experience working with clients in the BFSI sector, preferably with exposure to insurance engagements
* Strong 6-9 years of experience in Agile delivery methodologies
* Experience in end-to-end Agile delivery including sprint execution, backlog management, and stakeholder alignment
* Knowledge of one or more industry standard Agile PM tools – Jira or Azure Devops / Trello / Smartsheet / Confluence
* Knowledge of an Agile framework or method (i.e. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)
* Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills
* Ability to identify and remove blockers proactively and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working across cross-functional teams in Agile delivery environments
* Flexible to work in US and UK time zones

**Good to have**

* Experience working with Agile Transformation Project
* Understanding of waterfall methodologies
* JIRA administration and configuration knowledge
* Agile Coaching experience
* Business analysis skill
* Able to perform an Agile maturity assessment
* Exposure to insurance domain processes (claims, policy, billing, underwriting, etc.)

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Agile Project Manager
description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values which are Customer-Centric, Accountable, Innovative, Collaborative, and Action-Oriented. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around 1400 Spherions around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

**Role Overview**

This is an exciting time to join Sphera as we scale our product and technology organization, strengthen

our operating model, and lead the next phase of engineering productivity and AI-enabled delivery. This

role will help shape how Sphera grows: by improving execution clarity, enabling cross-functional

leadership, and driving measurable outcomes across a complex and high-impact product portfolio.

The Project Manager will support and lead cross-functional programs across Product, Engineering,

Architecture, QA, DevOps, Security, IT, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams. This role will

provide day-to-day program coordination, status tracking, risk and dependency management, and clear

communication for initiatives that require cross-team alignment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Program Leadership**

• Plan, execute, and track projects across multiple teams, workstreams, or product areas.

• Build project plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines.

• Coordinate alignment across Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, IT, Customer Success, and GTM.

• Keep projects focused on scope, schedule, budget, and quality commitments.

• Facilitate project meetings, stand-ups, and status reviews to keep teams on track.

**Executive Visibility and Governance**

• Prepare clear project status updates, RAID logs, and milestone tracking reports.

• Support leadership check-ins, sprint reviews, and project retrospectives.

• Summarize project details into concise updates, risks, and recommended next steps.

**Risk, Dependency, and Decision Management**

• Identify and track project risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies.

• Escalate issues in a timely manner with context and suggested options.

• Ensure action items and decisions are documented, assigned, and followed up on.

**Operating Model and Process Improvement**

• Follow and help refine Sphera's project management standards and best practices.

• Recommend improvements to templates, status reporting, and team workflows.

• Help distinguish between work needing formal tracking versus routine team delivery.

**Metrics and Delivery Insights**

• Maintain accurate project data in tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Track delivery metrics such as milestone progress, velocity, and task completion.

• Provide input to leadership on staffing needs, timeline risks, and project health.

**Change Management**

• Support planning and execution of change management activities for project rollouts, including

stakeholder communication and training plans.

• Assess change impact on teams and processes, and help develop mitigation and adoption plans.

• Partner with stakeholders to prepare teams for new tools, processes, or ways of working resulting

from project delivery.

• Track adoption and gather feedback post-implementation to ensure changes are sustained.

**Required Experience**

• 3+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, or a related delivery role.

• Experience supporting cross-functional software, SaaS, or technology projects.

• Working understanding of product development, SDLC, and release processes.

• Ability to collaborate with stakeholders across a matrixed organization.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including status updates and meeting summaries.

• Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, SharePoint, Confluence, or similar

platforms.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and adapting to shifting timelines.

**Preferred Experience**

• Experience in PE-backed, acquisition-heavy, or transformation-oriented environments.

• Exposure to change management practices and organizational adoption efforts.

• Familiarity with delivery metrics, sprint reporting, and project health dashboards.

• CAPM, PMP, PMI-ACP, or similar certification preferred but not required.

title: PLATFORM PRODUCT DELIVERY MANAGER – BUSINESS STEERING
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**

Are you a strong delivery leader within digital products and platforms, who enjoys leading cross-functional teams and creating real business impact
  
through technology? Do you thrive in complex environments where you balance product vision, engineering excellence, and operational performance?
  
  
If yes – keep reading, as this might be your next role!
  
We are looking for a Platform Product Delivery Manager to join IKEA Group Digital. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of digital products within a platform subdomain, ensuring they are built and operated with quality, scalability, and business value in mind. You are someone who inspires others, builds strong teams, and creates clarity in complex situations. You combine a strong customer focus with a deep understanding of technology and delivery, and you have the ability to translate insights into tangible product outcomes. Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high-quality digital products that make a difference.
  
  
Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
  
• Strong Experience in Business Steering solutions such as Market Share, Service optimisation, PnL …
  
• Strong experience in leading cross-functional product and engineering teams
  
• Experience leading teams across the full cycle of a product build journey
  
• Good understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices
  
• Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome-oriented ways of working
  
• Ability to define and measure success through KPIs and OKRs
  
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  
• Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
  
• A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement
  
• Proven ability to define a meaningful product roadmap even in contexts where the end-state is not yet determined
  
• Able to lead teams through uncertainty, with transparency and care

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US**

As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers. You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies. You will also play a key role in building strong, high-performing teams and enabling ways of working that support speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  
• Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of digital products (discovery → development → deployment → operations → adoption → pivot/persevere decisions)
  
• Drive product and engineering execution, including prioritisation, delivery speed, and quality
  
• Promote modern engineering practices such as automation and continuous improvement
  
• Ensure operational excellence, including availability, performance, and compliance requirements
  
• Remove blockers and manage cross-team dependencies to enable smooth delivery flow
  
• Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering ownership, accountability, and collaboration
  
• Use data, KPIs, and insights to drive decisions and continuously improve outcomes
  
• Contribute to reducing technical debt and improving long-term product sustainability
  
• Lead through change and uncertainty with a structured, pragmatic, and positive mindset

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will be part of Group Digital, where we set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast-moving and uncertain world. We develop and operate digital products and platforms that support the entire IKEA value chain and enable better experiences for both customers and co-workers.
  
You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, and Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.

title: Scrum Master-Delivery Management Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
**Role: Delivery Management Engineer II**
Deliver high-quality work products within established timelines while helping Agile teams improve how they plan, execute, and deliver work. As a Delivery Management Engineer II, you will serve as a Scrum Master for product and engineering teams, facilitate Scrum practices, support team effectiveness, and help remove barriers to delivery. You will also work with stakeholders, Product Owners, and delivery teams to promote transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle, while supporting the adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled engineering practices within the pod.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Delivery Management Engineer II on the Engineering-as-a-Service team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Facilitating Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

* Strong hands-on automation experience using C# and Selenium.

* Ability to guide QA engineers while remaining hands-on in testing and quality delivery.

* Passionate about manual testing excellence and automation maturity.

* Strong written/verbal communication skills and continuous improvement mindset.

title: Advanced Engineer - Connectivity
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
As a Advanced Engineer at HARMAN’s Automotive Connectivity Bluetooth and Wi Fi team, you will design and develop reusable, scalable embedded software components for all customer programs.
  
  
You’ll work with a product mindset - transforming complex customer and platform requirements into modular, configurable, plug-and-play software components that are easy to integrate, maintain, and scale across different vehicle programs.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Drive end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of Bluetooth and Wi-Fi features across multiple automotive infotainment programs.
* Own program tracking, milestone management, feature readiness, and delivery commitments aligned to customer and project timelines.
* Coordinate with development, validation, platform, product, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely feature execution and issue resolution.
* Represent connectivity program status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans in internal, customer, and leadership reviews.
* Monitor feature progress, defect trends, and release readiness through project dashboards and actionable metrics.
* Ensure feature planning, backlog management, and Functional Product Documentation (FPD) availability in alignment with program milestones.
* Lead Agile execution, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and daily execution tracking.
* Drive defect triage, prioritization, and closure activities while ensuring timely resolution of critical program issues.
* Work closely with local and global teams to debug complex system-level issues and remove delivery roadblocks.
* Collaborate with customers, chipset vendors, and internal stakeholders to align technical expectations and program deliverables.
* Support new business opportunities by participating in RFQs, effort estimations, solution reviews, and technical discussions.
* Identify program risks, technical dependencies, and resource constraints early, and drive mitigation plans proactively.
* Ensure compliance with Automotive SPICE (ASPICE), Agile processes, and Harman software development best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by driving process optimization, delivery efficiency, and reusable connectivity assets across programs.
* Provide clear and timely communication of project status, key decisions, and execution plans to stakeholders at all levels.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7 to 10 years of experience in Automotive Software Development, Technical Program Management, Project Coordination, or Technical Project Management roles.
* Hands-on experience with project management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, ELVIS, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of Bluetooth, Wi-Fi technologies, automotive connectivity use cases, and infotainment systems.
* Good knowledge of Android and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) architecture, along with the infotainment software development lifecycle.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, including Sprint Planning, Sprint Execution, Scrum ceremonies, and release management.
* Good understanding of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE), software development processes, and quality compliance requirements.
* Proven experience in feature tracking, milestone planning, First Pass Delivery (FPD) management, dependency management, and overall program execution.
* Expertise in project status reporting, dashboard creation, risk management, issue tracking, and preparation of leadership and customer presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across platform, product, project, development, and validation teams.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams and driving issue resolution through cross-functional engagement.
* Exposure to board bring-up activities, hardware debugging, and system-level troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of automotive application processors and SoCs such as Qualcomm, Exynos, NXP, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of networking concepts, serial communication protocols, storage subsystems, and embedded software architectures.
* Experience supporting RFQ activities, effort estimation, project planning, technical reviews, and execution tracking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present technical and program status updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership teams.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and execution excellence, with a strong focus on meeting delivery commitments while adhering to established processes and quality standards.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Worked in SAFe Agile environment. Good understanding of Automotive Infotainment SW Components.
* Knowledge of Hardware Bring ups & handle them. Connectivity Technologies/Protocols like RTP/RTSP/SIP expertise.

**Things To Know**

* This role is based at HARMAN International (India) Private Limited, Salarpuria Sattva Knowledge Court (SSKC), Bangalore.
* The position follows a hybrid work model with three mandatory days in office each week to support effective collaboration, design discussions, whiteboarding, demos, and faster issue resolution.
* In-office collaboration is important for this role, as the work often requires close coordination with architects, developers, product owners, and integration teams.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

This role ensures that all automation initiatives move seamlessly through the critical stages (Planning PO - UAT → Process Documentation → Training → Go-Live → Support → Impact Measurement), with clear accountability at each stage and synchronized delivery across Operations.This is a business-facing role centred on planning, project management, delivery orchestration, change enablement, not technical development which is managed by the technology organisation. Define and enforce gate review processes. Hold role leads accountable for stage deliverables: UAT sign-off → Process Documentation complete → Training delivered → Go-live readiness → Support SLA achieved → Impact measured. Make go/no-go decisions with Steering Group. Escalate blockers and risks immediately to sponsor/leadership.Role Coordination & AccountabilityRecruit and staff the 5 core roles (Ops UAT Lead, Process & QMS Lead, Innovation Lead, SME Expert, Change Champion). Ensure role clarity through RACI matrix ownership. Manage role interdependencies so that outputs from one stage properly feed into the next. Conduct weekly 1-on-1 check-ins with each role lead to track progress, identify blockers, and adjust workload. Act as the RACI translator when accountability is unclear.Steering Group Leadership & Gate GovernanceChair weekly Steering Group meetings (Operations Lead, Innovation Lead, Process & QMS Lead, Change Champion, SME Expert, Finance rep). Facilitate status updates, gate reviews, risk escalation, and dependency management. Maintain Stage Gate Register tracking which gates have passed, which are pending, and which carry risk. Ensure decisions are documented and communicated. Escalate critical blockers to C-level when necessary.Delivery Timeline & Risk ManagementDevelop and maintain the master deployment timeline from UAT kickoff through post-launch impact review. Identify and manage dependencies between stages and roles; flag risks where delays in one stage will impact downstream stages. Track schedule vs. planned dates; communicate delays and recovery actions proactively. Maintain RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies); review and escalate weekly. Forecast go-live and impact review dates based on gate outcomes.Change Communications & Stakeholder AlignmentDevelop deployment communications plan covering awareness, training, go-live messaging, and post-launch updates. Address resistance and concerns early; work with Change Champion to surface and resolve adoption blockers.Go-Live Orchestration & Support ReadinessCreate go-live runbook: deployment sequence, cutover plan, rollback procedures, support escalation paths. Coordinate go-live rehearsals (1–2 dry runs before live day). Act as on-call Command Center lead during go-live; own decision-making on escalations and rollback. Ensure Support Team is staffed and ready. Oversee transition from Innovation Lead to operations support. title: Scrum Master/Project Manager/BA
description:
**Role:Scrum Master/Project Manager/BA**

**Location:Bengaluru/Hybrid**

**Long Term Contract Opportunity**

**Job Description**

* We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Product Owner to support the delivery of digital, data, analytics, and AI-enabled products. The Product Owner will work closely with business stakeholders, product managers, engineers, designers, and data teams to translate business needs into actionable requirements and ensure successful product delivery.

* This role is ideal for an early-career product professional who is comfortable working in Agile teams, managing requirements, prioritization, and coordinating delivery activities across multiple stakeholders. The individual will also support validation, compliance, and governance processes required for technology products operating in a regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Delivery & Backlog Management**

* Support the creation and maintenance of the product backlog.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and user needs.
* Write and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
* Work with engineering teams to clarify requirements and resolve questions during development.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Assist with release planning and deployment coordination.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand priorities and desired outcomes.
* Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, and product demonstrations.
* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions to stakeholders.
* Support product managers and senior product owners in roadmap execution and planning activities.

**Product Operations & Adoption**

* Track product performance metrics and support reporting activities.
* Collect and document user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) planning and execution.
* Support change management, training, and adoption activities when required.

**Validation, Compliance & Governance**

* Coordinate product validation activities in alignment with Lilly quality and compliance requirements.
* Support preparation and maintenance of validation documentation, test evidence, traceability records, and release approvals.
* Partner with engineering, business, quality, and compliance teams to ensure required governance activities are completed on time.
* Support CSQA reviews and other technology validation processes as applicable.
* Coordinate AI Registry submissions and required documentation for AI-enabled products.
* Maintain records related to product governance, risk assessments, and audit readiness.
* Track validation and compliance action items and ensure timely closure.
* Identify potential compliance or validation risks and escalate appropriately.

**Agile Team Participation**

* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for product-related questions from the development team.
* Support prioritization decisions based on business value and stakeholder needs.
* Ensure backlog items are sufficiently defined before development begins.
* Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and technical leads to enable efficient delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong requirement gathering and documentation skills.
* Experience creating user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting digital, analytics, data, or AI/ML products.
* Familiarity with CSQA, CSV, validation, or technology governance processes.
* Exposure to AI governance frameworks and AI Registry processes.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries.
* Understanding of data governance, privacy, and compliance principles.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms, data engineering, or analytics solutions.

**Key Competencies**

* Product Thinking
* Requirement Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Agile Delivery
* Documentation & Traceability
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Continuous Learning

**Success Measures**

* Quality and completeness of product requirements and user stories.
* Timely backlog refinement and sprint readiness.
* Successful delivery of planned product increments.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and responsiveness.
* Compliance with validation and governance requirements.
* Completion of CSQA, AI Registry, and release documentation activities on schedule.
* Adoption and business value delivered by product features.

* Standardize JIRA reporting across products within In\-Center domain

* Facilitate Risk identification, escalation, and resolution.
* Proactive problem\-solving and escalation handling

* Collaborate with Product Owners and business leaders to define and refine the product roadmap.
* Ensure data governance, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within the team’s Agile processes.

* Foster a culture of innovation within Agile teams by encouraging experimentation, process improvements, and adoption of new technologies.
* Identify opportunities to enhance Agile workflows, automate manual processes, and optimize data\-driven decision\-making.

title: Technical Programme Manager
description:
**About the role**
 The Online Technology team have led the way in delivering outcomes which are driving the transformation of the Tesco Technology platform: We have significantly grown the number of customers who rely on us to deliver their shopping to their home or convenient location. We saw substantial increases in volumes and customers through the pandemic which tested and proved the scalability of the platform. These increases saw use regularly exceed over 1\.3m orders a week though the retail platform.Since then we have scaled and changed the landscape of what we sell online by launching multiple propositions such as Whoosh, Marketplace and recently F\&F. Over the next few years we will be significantly growing Whoosh, continuously pushing the Marketplace proposition and scaling our Clothing mission to become the one stop shop. 
   

  

 Sitting in the Online team does not mean you are bound by the restrictions of Clothing, Marketplace, Groceries or Whoosh. We often are interfacing with the multiple business units and missions a customer comes to the website and app to fulfil, you will be part of the Online integrated programme, product and engineering space. The Online programme team unlock real world value for our customers across multiple shopping missions.
   

  

**You will be responsible for**
 Technical Programme Managers (TPMs) deliver complex, cross\-functional technology programmes that support colleagues and help serve our customers better. They work collaboratively, influence Product, Engineering and business colleagues and lead the programme to deliver value quickly and often.
   

 Whilst specific responsibilities will be dependent upon the changing needs of the Tesco business, the following provides an overview of the role’s key responsibilities and measures:
   

 • Deliver programmes with business and/or technical risks• Optimise or use a standard programme delivery methodology for delivering programme goals (e.g. agile, waterfall, iterative) • Bring together, coordinate and energise virtual technology teams to deliver programme goals• Create and track a plan to deliver the programme goals, including the technical implementation plan• Understand trade\-offs and resulting impacts; make impacts visible to Product, Infrastructure or Engineering for the right decision to be made • Managing dependencies, delivery timelines and implementations plans, using my knowledge of technical architecture• Appreciating and responding to delivery challenges, using my knowledge of engineering best practices and/or infrastructure implementations• Understand technology concepts, grasp new ones quickly and appreciate their implications on delivery• Effectively manage major incidents, ensuring stakeholders are updated with the right information to drive the correct decisions• Build positive relationships with suppliers \& external stakeholders to deliver software or professional services• Coach peers and other roles, teaching where required, on methodologies and programme management tools• This role will best suit an individual who enjoys working as part of a team, is well organised, pragmatic and a lateral thinker with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and, most importantly, puts our customers first.
   

  

**You will need**
 You’ll need to have:
   

 • A proven accomplished record of delivering technology and/or infrastructure; having done so across multiple teams in multiple geographies• Experience of building credible relationships and influencing management and leadership teams• Excellent verbal and written communication skills – you must be able to articulate complex concepts to a diverse audience.• The ability to influence without authority.Personal
   

 • Flexibility, ability to plan and organise, responsiveness, creativity, self\-starter • Demonstrate resilience during change and continue delivery
   

  

**Whats in it for you?**
  

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
   

  
   

 As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
   

  
   

 Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
   

  
   

 Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \-simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
   

  
   

**Salary** 
 \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
   

  
   

**Leave \& Time\-off** 
 \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
   

  
   

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** 
 \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
   

  
   

**Health is Wealth** 
 \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws. 
   

  
   

**Mental Wellbeing** 
 \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
   

  
   

**Financial Wellbeing** 
 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: Product Management and Software Engineering Intern
description:
Sapiensu is looking for a product management and engineering intern.
 



  





 Sapiensu reads the public record on a company or an individual and returns findings a deal team can act on, and still defend six months later in front of an investment committee, a lender or a regulator.
 



  





 Learn more here: www.sapiensu.com
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 One person doing two jobs.
 



  





 You will write and ship code in the product, and you will work on the product itself: sitting in customer conversations, reading back what was said, and helping decide what gets built next.
 



  





 This is not a shadowing role. The product is built and in use by external testers.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WOULD BE WORKING ON** 




  





 \- Customer development against a waitlist who signed up before there was a product to show them, and helping work out which of them we should be building for.
 



 \- Sitting in user conversations and turning what you hear into decisions about what we build next.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




  





 \- Evidence that you have built something and finished it. A side project, a tool, a repository. It does not have to be polished and it does not have to be in our domain.
 



 \- Genuine curiosity about why people behave as they do, and the willingness to change your mind when a user contradicts you.
 



 \- Comfort in a very small team with no structured on boarding and no training programme.
 



  





 You do not need prior experience in finance, law or diligence.
 



  





 You do need to be interested in why a finding has to survive being challenged six months after it is written.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Comfortable with React and TypeScript; working knowledge of at least one of Python, Rust, or Go
* Prior exposure to backend, data, or AI/LLM APIs
* Quick learner, comfortable with ambiguity, and curious about new industries



  





**TERMS** 




  





 Stipend, commensurate to experience and qualifications. Three months, full\-time, in person in Bengaluru.
 



  





 If you perform well, there is a real possibility of a full\-time role at the end of the internship. We would rather state it that way than promise something we cannot guarantee in advance.
 



  





**TO APPLY** 




  





 Email your resume to parita@sapiensu.com with something you have built, and a paragraph on why you want to work on this (do not use AI, write it yourself).

title: QA Manager
description:
We are seeking a QA Manager with 8\-12 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, including experience leading QA teams in fast\-paced product environments.
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on quality leader with strong expertise in both manual and automation testing, a proven track record of driving high\-velocity daily releases, and the ability to build and develop high\-performing QA teams. This individual will be responsible for the quality strategy for Indee's products while actively contributing to release planning, testing initiatives, process improvements, automation efforts, and production quality outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously evolve Indee's QA strategy across manual, automation, regression, exploratory, API, performance, and release testing.
* Lead QA efforts throughout the software development lifecycle, including test planning, test execution, defect management, risk assessment, release validation, and release sign\-offs.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled testing approaches and continuously evaluate opportunities to improve testing efficiency, quality, and coverage.
* Drive release quality by establishing strong validation processes, improving regression coverage, and minimizing production defects.
* Define, track, and report on key quality metrics, including production defect leakage, release readiness, automation coverage, defect trends, and test effectiveness.
* Conduct root cause analysis for production issues and implement preventive actions to improve product quality and release stability.
* Drive automation initiatives across the QA function, improving automation coverage, framework reliability, execution efficiency, and long\-term maintainability.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and improve testing effectiveness through API\-based and UI\-based automation approaches.
* Mentor and develop QA engineers across manual and automation testing disciplines, supporting skill development, career growth, and technical excellence.
* Enable manual QA engineers to contribute to automation efforts through coaching, structured ownership, and ongoing support.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing, release, and production support.
* Support timely investigation, validation, and resolution of customer\-reported issues, production incidents, and QA\-related escalations.
* Improve release planning, workload allocation, and team capacity management to support multiple concurrent projects and business priorities.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the QA team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, capacity planning, and succession planning.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing team culture that promotes ownership, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.



  





**Requirement** 




**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
 



  





**Experience:** 



* 8\-12 years of QA experience in product companies. Candidates whose experience is exclusively in IT services environments may not be the best fit for this role.
* 4\+ years of experience managing/leading QA teams.



  





**Must\-Haves:** 



* Strong people leadership and planning skills
* Ability to schedule work with tight timelines without overworking the team.
* Strong hands\-on experience in QA of web and mobile applications.
* Experience in test automation using Selenium with Python, leveraging BDD frameworks.
* Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of test strategy, test planning, regression testing, defect management, and release validation processes.
* Experience leading QA for production releases and driving release sign\-off decisions.
* Experience defining, tracking, and analyzing quality metrics and release health indicators.
* Strong understanding of root cause analysis and defect prevention methodologies.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong background in CI/CD pipelines
* Strong capabilities in git/github
* Strong experience in JIRA, issue tracking, JIRA customization, and reporting.
* Experience with Appium or mobile automation frameworks.



  





**Good\-to\-Haves:** 



* Exposure to performance testing
* Understanding of ISO\-27001 processes and frameworks
* Understanding of SOC\-2 compliance and application / QA\-specific needs.
* Exposure to security and penetration testing.

title: Data Test Analyst
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Data Test Analyst**
**Purpose of the role**
 The role resides within the Data Management Change Team, reporting to the Data Change Lead in Bangalore. The position is for a Data Business Analyst within the Data Analytics Office, focused on supporting operational business teams with requirements that depend on Asset Management Data Services. You will work across multiple data services and operational teams to support data service delivery aligned to stakeholder needs, with an initial focus on Security, Holdings and Environmental, Social and Governance data services and vendor data delivery to performance and reporting, client business, and investment teams.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Elicit, interpret, and translate stakeholder conversations and written inputs into clear business requirements and functional requirements to support development and testing.
* Produce high\-quality business requirements and functional requirements documentation in line with project expectations and governance.
* Participate in, and where required chair, project and analysis meetings, clearly communicating outcomes, actions, and next steps.
* Define and support testing activities, including planning and executing data testing aligned to requirements and agreed test scenarios.
* Proactively explore brief requirements raised through Jira stories to achieve full clarity, identify gaps, and drive alignment across stakeholders.
* Manage defects for assigned deliveries, including tracking, prioritising, following up on fixes, and coordinating re\-testing with relevant teams.
* Communicate confidently and effectively, asking the right questions, challenging constructively when needed, and providing clear responses to stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with global and regional business and technology teams across time zones, contributing to delivery momentum and shared outcomes.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Minimum 6 years’ relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in business analysis, including translating business needs into business requirements and functional requirements.
* Strong experience partnering with developers and testing teams to deliver outcomes aligned to documented requirements.
* In\-depth knowledge of holdings data, securities data, ESG data services, and ESG data providers.
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong SQL skills (querying data, joining tables, using primary keys for analysis) and experience across Agile and Waterfall lifecycles, with hands\-on use of tools such as Quality Centre and Jira.


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
**Hsbc.Com/Careers**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
