title: Engineer III, Software Test
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Job Description**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements Or Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 




  
 




**Job summary** 






 The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a single engineering team to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions. This role focuses on day‑to‑day technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution within a defined product or platform area. The Engineering Manager works closely with Product, Architecture, and Operations to ensure the team delivers high‑quality outcomes aligned to roadmap and business goals.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Technical Leadership 
 
	+ Lead technical execution for a specific product, service, or platform area.
	+ Ensure designs and implementations follow established architecture, security, and reliability standards.
	+ Promote best practices in coding, code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance tuning.
	+ Partner with senior engineers and architects to plan and implement refactoring, modernization, and tech‑debt reduction.
* People \& Team Management
 
	+ Manage, coach, and develop a team of software engineers and senior engineers.
	+ Set clear goals and performance expectations; provide regular feedback and run effective1:1s.
	+ Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
	+ Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development to build a strong, diverse team.
* Delivery \& Execution
 
	+ Collaborate with Product Management to refine scope, priorities, and release timelines for the team.
	+ Own sprint planning, execution, and delivery for the team’s backlog.
	+ Ensure high quality through testing, code reviews, and adherence to SDLC and compliance standards.
	+ Identify risks and blockers early and drive resolution through coordination with partner teams.
* Operational Excellence
 
	+ Monitor and improve the health of the services owned by the team (reliability, latency, errors, cost).
	+ Participate in incident management, on‑call rotations, and RCAs; ensure follow‑through on action items.
	+ Drive incremental improvements in stability, automation, and operational efficiency for the team's services.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
 
	+ Work closely with Product, Architecture, SRE/DevOps, Security, and QA to ensure alignment from design to release.
	+ Represent the team in project discussions, status updates, and stakeholder reviews.
	+ Translate product and business requirements into clear, actionable work for the team.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2–4 years in a people‑leading role.
* Hands‑on experience building and operating services on modern cloud platforms(AWS/GCP/Azure) and frameworks (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or similar).
* Strong understanding of agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Proven ability to lead a team to deliver high‑quality software on time.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Experience working with distributed systems, APIs, and microservices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure/observability tooling.
* Experience collaborating with or leading cross‑geo or remote teams.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, or regulated SaaS environments.
* Interest or exposure to AI/ML or data‑driven product development.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support



  
 




 To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

title: Z3_Lead Scrum Master|Scrum Master
description:
**Req ID:** 
 381972
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Z3\_Lead Scrum Master\|Scrum Master to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Summary:** 
 As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within our organization, ensuring the company can work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high\-quality solutions. You will work closely with the product development team to ensure that the work progresses on schedule, within budget, and to the desired level of quality. Additionally, you will serve as a coach and mentor to our team – helping to foster a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring that the team is meeting its objectives consistently.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-up meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach the development team in Agile and Scrum practices to ensure that they understand and embrace the methodology.
* Help the team remove obstacles to progress, while empowering them to take ownership of the process.
* Ensure the development team is following Scrum practices and helping them continuously improve their performance.
* Help prioritize and manage the product backlog to ensure that the team is always working on the most valuable items.
* Act as a liaison between the development team and stakeholders to ensure that everyone is aligned and informed about the progress of the project.
* Ensure that the team is delivering high\-quality software that meets customer requirements on time.
* Identify and troubleshoot obstacles that are hindering the team's progress.
* Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives and feedback sessions.
* Communicate project status, risks and issues to stakeholders.
* Track KPIs and help teams deliver high\-quality products/solutions on time.
* Ensure that the team follows the Scrum framework and adheres to Agile principles.
* Training, mentoring, and supporting scrum teams to follow agile values, principles, and practices.
* Determining and managing tasks, issues, risks, and action items.
* Planning and organizing demos and product/system testing.
* Ensuring the proper use of collaborative processes and removing impediments for the scrum team.
* Tracking project processes, deliverables, and financials.
* Preparing and presenting status reports to stakeholders.
* ART and PI Planning.


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 7\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
* Strong knowledge of Agile Scrum principles and practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to lead and facilitate Scrum ceremonies.
* Exemplifies and promotes Agile values and principles.
* Outstanding communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills.
* Knowledge of an agile framework or method (i.e. Scrum, Kanban), or understanding of software development life cycle models as well as in\-depth knowledge of traditional project management principles and practices.
* Adept at refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity, retrospection, and other Scrum techniques.


**Preferred Skills and Qualifications:**
* Certification in Agile methodologies, like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
* SAFe certification and Kanban certification are a plus.
* Coaching and PI planning experience is mandatory
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Prior knowledge of Agile project management tool such as Jira.

* Support to team for Testing, Support during Production issues etc. would be beneficial.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 DIGIS Tribes develop and maintain applications for Business Lines Avionics Global Services AGS, inside Thales GBU AVS.
   

  

 AVS business lines provides, all around the world, customer support and maintenance of avionics Thales equipment.
   

  

 The applications are built on top and outside SAP ERP. Their main business goals are to facilitate users’ day\-to\-day works (logisticians, repair technicians, marketing, sales, …) and improve overall industrial performance.
   

  

 Such applications need to be connected in real time to SAP ERP, through OData web services, to read, update or delete data (SAP objects). We also have multiple reports and dashboards executed from SAP as wel.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to join our agile delivery team. The Scrum Master will be responsible for facilitating scrum ceremonies, coaching teams on agile best practices, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Review, Retrospective) effectively and efficiently.
* Act as a servant leader and coach to Agile teams, promoting agile values, principles, and practices.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners to manage and prioritize the product backlog.
* Remove impediments and blockers that hinder team progress.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging feedback, team collaboration, and learning.
* Track and report key agile metrics (e.g., velocity, burn\-down charts) to stakeholders.
* Support cross\-team collaboration and coordination in a scaled agile environment.
* Assist teams in delivering high\-quality software incrementally and iteratively.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote a positive and productive team dynamic.
* Engage with stakeholders at various levels to ensure transparency and alignment.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of experience working as a Scrum Master or in an agile team environment.
* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile certifications preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to remove blockers and resolve conflicts.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-functional teams.

title: Program Management Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for an energetic, service minded leader, who enjoys helping others to succeed by providing team members and clients with motivation and support in a positive and professional work environment as a Software Program Management Engineer. We are seeking a highly motivated individual who will challenge teammates to achieve flawless execution goals, while maintaining strong working relationships. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deliver SW products to set scope, ontime and with quality and driving the SW teams to meet and exceed the business needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Own end\-to\-end SW program delivery – from scoping and planning through integration, verification, and customer ramp.
* Work across Design, Marketing, Systems \& Applications to align the SW scope and schedule needs as well as the priorities driving the tradeoff choices within the development cycle as the need arises
* Build and maintain program schedules; track milestones, monitor and manage external dependencies(including other functions and third parties), surface risks early, and drive resolution of blocking issues across teams.
* Coordinate development dependencies between various SW teams \- middleware, tools, verification, and application engineering teams.
* Serve as the primary interface to customers for SW release plans, delivery commitments, and issue escalations.
* Drive ASPICE compliance across SW projects; prepare teams for internal and third\-party audits, enable any necessary certifications.
* Lead program reviews and status reporting to senior leadership; translate engineering progress into clear, decision\-ready summaries.
* Partner with technical leads to scope new feature requests, estimate effort, and align resource capacity with roadmap commitments.
* Identify process inefficiencies in the SW delivery flow and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor project leads and engineers on program management practices, customer\-facing communication as well as any other project specific planning and procurement needs


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelors in Electronics, Electrical or Computer Engineering or related engineering degree
* 5\-12 years of experience with project engineering/management experience on complex SW products/projects (Baremetal and LLOS)
* Proven leadership capabilities in working across multifaceted global organizations
* Successful proven track record in indirect management and influence
* Strong combination of technical, communication, execution and leadership capabilities


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of embedded SW development – C programming, RTOS concepts, MCU architecture (ARM Cortex\-M/R), and SW build/integration flows.
* Familiarity with AUTOSAR architecture (MCAL, BSW, RTE, application layers) and automotive SW development lifecycle.
* Experience with functional safety standards and process frameworks: ISO 26262, ASPICE (CL2 or higher).
* Proficiency with program tracking tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent.
* Experience with defect triage processes, release management, and customer delivery workflows.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and set realistic plans based on required tasks with available resources
* Ability to effectively coordinate and lead global development teams on projects that include both New SW products, post production maintenance SW
* Ability to provide clear direction to both internal teams and external support organizations on project priorities in alignment with the business needs
* Proven program management skills – schedule management, risk identification, dependency tracking, and milestone ownership across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including hardware, verification, tools, and customer applications.
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. description:

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

 The Software Design Assurance Team is responsible for ensuring our software products meet quality, reliability, and release\-readiness standards throughout the development lifecycle. The design assurance team supports Zebra’s promise of quality to our customers and is responsible for participating in design reviews, sprint refinement, build/release operations, and post\-mortems, and process gap analysis to conduct release readiness assessment. This position works with a minimum level of supervision.
   

  

 This position is hybrid based in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Perform an analysis of SW Design Assurance for cloud\-native SaaS Technology products and provide feedback for all the key Quality Metrics and deliverables executed by the functional teams, including:
   

  

* Responsible for SW Quality assessment of SWS \& cloud solutions. Identify deviations from stated product goals, standards, and processes.
* Perform Software Quality Reviews, measure and monitor progress of programs under development.
* Lead and conduct Product Release readiness reviews ensuring release criteria for software \& device solutions are met and communicate all quality issues, risks, requirements gap prior to product approval.
* Recommend latest technologies and new approaches to design and implementation of new technology
* Should have strong knowledge of cause\-and\-effect relation between SW defects and potential customer impact use cases.
* Instrument the product CI/CD pipeline and surface build\-stage quality signal — code coverage trends, flaky\-test detection, build stability, deployment frequency, and rollback rate — as a living engineering dashboard rather than a downstream report.
* Experience with Software\-as\-a\-Service development processes, release automation, observability tooling, and quality metrics for distributed cloud systems.
* Knowledge of the SDLC, testing concepts, methodologies, metrics, automated SW testing frameworks
* Experience in delivery and manage multi release projects in AGILE (Scrum, Scaled Agile) and knowledge of SW tools like JIRA, Confluence and Power BI
* Guidance of the process, test methodologies, test strategy used in production of Zebra's NSI SW products and solutions including Software Stability, Stress, and performance strategies
* Experience communicating cross\-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings
* Actively participate in SW Product and applications Risk Assessment and mitigation activities

* Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related).
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in Software Engineering, with at least 5 years in site reliability, release engineering, or senior quality engineering roles on SaaS / cloud\-native systems.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and release\-automation tooling — able to instrument systems directly, not only interpret dashboards.
* Demonstrated experience with modern test architecture across unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end layers; flaky\-test triage; regression\-suite design; and test\-pyramid discipline applied to refactor\-heavy codebases.
* Software QA automation experience with technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, or comparable.

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver an independent quality recommendation to an engineering team in which the engineer is embedded — without compromising the working relationship.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Production\-incident and release\-health fluency — comfortable leading post\-mortems, building escape\-defect feedback loops, and translating field signal into engineering priorities; credibility built from on\-call experience.
* Experience with multi\-tenant enterprise SaaS domains and complex customer\-facing platforms.
* Experience working as an embedded quality / SRE partner inside a product engineering team, with demonstrated ability to maintain independent judgment while operating inside the team's day\-to\-day rituals.
* Experience communicating cross\-functionally and across management levels — including engineering leadership, customer success, and quality leadership — in formal and informal settings.
* Ability to actively engage business and technology partners; present, defend, and challenge technical recommendations.
* Ability to deal with ambiguity effectively and exercise sound judgment when evidence is incomplete.
* Advocate for the customer and drive the highest standard of quality at every stage of the product lifecycle.
* Instill best practices for software development, testing, and observability documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver high\-quality work on tight schedules.
* Strong analytical skills and a methodical, objective approach to problem\-solving.

 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Key Job Responsibilities And Duties**
 As a
 **Software Engineering Manager** 
 you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.
   

  

 Important aspects of the job include:
   

  

* Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth. Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.

Reduce operational risk by applying state\-of\-the\-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.

You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* Lead, develop, and mentor a software engineering team delivering mobile and cloud software solutions supporting Dexcom products and services.
* Establish and communicate team priorities and execution plans aligned with product and organizational objectives.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing, Systems Engineering, and other stakeholders to define requirements, plan development activities, and ensure successful product delivery.

* Drive software development best practices across mobile and cloud applications, including iOS and Android development, cloud services, Agile methodologies, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development practices, and performance monitoring.
* Provide technical guidance and contribute to software architecture and design decisions across mobile and cloud systems to ensure scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and product quality.
* Manage team staffing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee development, and resource planning activities.
* Use key performance indicators (KPIs), engineering metrics, and operational data to monitor team effectiveness, delivery performance, and product quality and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across the organization to manage interfaces and dependencies, share knowledge, improve development practices, and support successful end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Identify and manage technical, schedule, quality, security, and execution risks, escalating significant issues and tradeoffs when appropriate.
* Partner with Quality, V\&V, Cybersecurity, and other engineering functions to ensure software solutions meet functional, performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities, inspections, and regulatory submissions as required.
* Foster strong cross\-functional relationships and advocate for engineering quality, technical excellence, effective execution, and continuous improvement.


**What Makes You Successful**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of software development experience, including experience delivering complex software products.
* 3\+ years of people management experience leading software engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading, developing, and mentoring a software engineering team.
* Strong experience with mobile and/or cloud application development, including iOS, Android, cloud services, or other connected software platforms.
* Experience delivering software products through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, verification, release, and maintenance.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering/Architecture
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Senior Manager, Software Engineering/Architecture is a management role, tasked with managing a team of developers, engineers and/or architects by planning, directing and coordinating team activities to ensure that customer and business expectations are met.
   

  

 This role ensures that software engineering and architecture projects are delivered on time and within the agreed budget whilst meeting the required quality standards.
   

  

 The Senior Manager, Software Engineering/Architecture participates in the development of standards, policies and procedures related to the function.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Sets operational objectives of the software engineering/architecture team, setting goals to ensure timely project delivery.
* Provides guidance in the development, planning, directing, coordination and management of the processes related to software engineering/architecture initiatives and projects.
* Collaborates with internal and external partners to address issues and concerns, resolving them promptly.
* Ensures that the relevant procedures and processes are in place and followed throughout the software engineering/architecture lifecycle.
* Guides on the architectural vision by providing input to translating product requirements into work items that the team can perform and ensures that the tasks are accomplished.
* Manages resources and streamlines processes to ensure deliverables are met within the expected timeline.
* Provides guidance on the design and execution of the software engineering/architecture lifecycle and assisting with the associated activities as and when required.
* Provides guidance on detailed quality assurance and automated testing requirements, processes and guidelines.
* Recommends guidelines on which technologies to leverage to enable scalable system architecture designs.
* Collaborates regularly with product owners and works closely with end users to translate the requirements to the team.
* Provides guidance on the execution of projects from conception to implementation, regularly reporting on project status.
* Ensures the requests for proposals (RFP) are responded to with complete timelines, deliverables and budget.
* Guides on the documentation of release packages and ensures the team has access to new releases.
* Remains up to date with current technologies and is aware of upcoming and new technologies.
* Instils best practices for software engineering and architecture documentation, assuring designs meet requirements and delivers high quality.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Extended understanding of the regulatory, risk and compliance environment and requirements.
* Extended understanding of programming languages, complex programming applications and troubleshooting.
* Extended understanding of software development, engineering and architecture life cycle process and methodologies.
* Extended understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Extended understanding of all processes related to software including analysis, development, architecture, engineering, design, coding, system and user testing, problem resolution and planning.
* Extended understanding of build and release processes, environment management and source control management.
* Extended understanding of people practices and processes.
* Ability to build a cohesive team and to manage people effectively.
* Ability to balance and plan the short\-term and long\-term actions of the team.
* Ability to collaborate and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or related field.
* Relevant certifications required.


**Required experience:**
* Solid line manager experience in a technical lead capacity.
* Extended demonstrated experience building, managing and leading software development, engineering and/or architecture teams.
* Solid line manager experience dealing with relevant stakeholders, building strong relationships and negotiating with decision makers and influencers.
* Extended demonstrated experience of delivering large software projects, utilising Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Extended demonstrated experience of IT in a complex business environment with the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Extended demonstrated experience of negotiation or management of third\-party services.
* Extended demonstrated experience of developing and implementing relevant strategies in a multi supplier environment, managing third party services.
* Extended previous experience with line management responsibilities and/or allocation of resources within a department or project environment.


**Workplace type:**
 Hybrid Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
   

  

 Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
   

  

 responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
   

  

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

title: Functional Business Consultant
description:
**What We Do**
 msg global is a consulting and system integration company with a strong focus on the insurance and reinsurance industry. We support our clients in designing, transforming, and implementing integrated IT architectures across end‑to‑end business processes. With deep industry expertise, we deliver high‑quality SAP‑based solutions tailored to the specific requirements of insurance and reinsurance organizations.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate closely with msg global project teams and customer stakeholders to deliver SAP for reinsurance implementations. Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Analyzing, specifying, testing, and documenting reinsurance business processes
* Designing integrated and sustainable system landscapes
* Participating in process flow analysis, redesign, and business process optimization
* Designing transition maps, roadmaps, implementation, integration, and migration strategies
* Providing functional consulting expertise to reinsurance clients
* Defining best practices and evaluating third‑party solution alternatives as part of functional design documents
* Coordinating with business process owners and technical teams to design, customize, and implement SAP for reinsurance solutions
* Supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Participating in training, design, documentation, and delivery activities in alignment with the Project Manager
* Contributing to internal projects as required
* Traveling to client locations up to 80% of the time


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for an experienced and motivated professional with strong domain and consulting skills, including:
   

  

* Excellent knowledge of Reinsurance and insurance business processes, particularly for P\&C lines of business
* Several years of experience in business consulting and package‑based implementation projects
* Strong understanding of integrated IT architectures and SAP implementation methodologies (e.g., ASAP)
* Ability to manage complex initiatives with minimal supervision
* Very strong analytical, conceptual, and problem‑solving skills
* A proactive mindset with a strong willingness to learn
* Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic work environment
* Strong customer focus and a service‑oriented, self‑driven approach to work
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Experience working directly with clients, business stakeholders, and functional teams
* SAP for Insurance/Reinsurance knowledge is an added advantage


**What We Offer**
* A place where individuals are equally valued and where diversity and cultural differences are cherished.
* A global team of highly respected developers and industry experts where you can make a difference.
* Competitive salaries and a broad range of benefits, some of which are highlighted below.
* The opportunity to work on complex and challenging reinsurance transformation projects
* Exposure to global clients and collaboration with experienced international teams
* A key role in shaping business processes and IT architectures for leading reinsurance organizations
* A professional environment that values expertise, independence, and continuous learning
* Opportunities to contribute to both client projects and internal initiatives
* Career growth within a specialized reinsurance consulting organization


**Benefits**
* Health Insurance: We provide hospitalization and non\-hospitalization benefits like annual medical screening and mental health assistance program for employees and their dependents.
* Employee Wellbeing: We provide various options for sport and recreation benefits.
* Job for Friends: Get your friends on board through our employee referral program, and we will reward you.
* Flexible Working: We offer flexible work schedules, including flexible start and end times as well as remote and/or hybrid work.
* Anniversary \& Success Milestones: We celebrate your work anniversaries and success by rewarding your loyalty and dedication.
* Gift Vouchers: We share your happiness with you and provide vouchers for newborns, wedding, work anniversaries, annual and festival gifts.
* Team Events: We celebrate our success with team\-building activities throughout the year.
* Training and Development: We provide a broad training portfolio for personal and professional growth, including unlimited access to course platform to all our employees.

title: Agile Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI\-powered recruiting technology, data\-driven insights, and world\-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Agile Project Manager in Radancy's Product Engineering group, you will oversee the project management duties for software development projects from initiation through release, delivering new and enhanced products to our client base. The Agile Project Manager must be able to harness a distributed and multi\-functional team covering digital development in all its forms (design, IXD, content, UI development, engineering and quality assurance) and can facilitate dialogue between developers and stakeholders. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every one of the qualifications in a job description. Our top priority is finding the best candidate for the job and if you are interested in the position, we would encourage you to apply, even if you don’t believe you meet every one of the skills.
   

  

**What does a great Agile Project Manager do?**
* Serve as Project Manager for software/web development of new or enhanced products using agile methodology
* As Scrum Master, you will manage the processes for information exchange with the Agile teams
* Collaborate with globally distributed teams of product managers, developers, and QA testers to resource, define, and schedule activities required to develop and launch new software
* Define and enforce best project management practices
* Coordinate all production releases including weekly maintenance releases
* Provide management\-level reporting on project status, risks and mitigation strategies
* Administration of JIRA (boards, projects, users and permissions)
* Send out release notes communication to marketing/sales following releases


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (ideally in Business or Computer Science)
* 1\+ years of experience as a scrum master in a software development environment with a preference including experience with varied Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, XP)
* Experience managing projects among a distributed team spanning different geographies and diverse cultures
* Understanding of web development and associated technologies, and able to follow technical discussions and bridge communications between stakeholders and developers
* Scrum Master certification (CSM or PSM) desirable
* Excellent interpersonal communications, must have the ability to help product managers formulate/articulate a decision on the course of action
* Quick learner, able to work independently with limited supervision
* Self\-motivated, proactive and dependable
* Positive, committed and selfless, willing to pitch in and help others when needed
* Organized, meticulous, patient, able to works effectively under pressure
* Flexible to shifting��business priorities


**Work Location**
* Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.


**Company Values:**
 At Radancy, we are dedicated to the core values that guide our work and culture:
   

  

* Innovative Spirit Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what’s new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we’re shaping the future and leading the industry forward.
* Rewarding Impact Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people’s lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose.
* Performance Driven Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support.
* Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry\-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.


 Join the global leader in talent acquisition technologies that’s committed to finding new ways to leverage software, strategy and creative to enhance our clients’ employer brands – across every connection point. We’re looking for unconventional thinkers. Relentless collaborators. And ferocious innovators. Talented individuals who are ready to work towards solutions that transform the way employers and job seekers connect.
   

  

*Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive.*

title: Manager, Technical Professional Services
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Manager, Technical Professional Services
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, we’re embarking on a Digital Transformation journey, delivering world\-class Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) solutions through our Consumer Direct Interaction Organization (CDI XO). As part of a Delivery team embedded at a Digital Product Organization, we are looking for a skilled Release Manager to join our dynamic team, supporting our growth across Europe, APAC, and the Americas. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring the quality of our cutting\-edge solutions, all while working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment across multiple Agile Release Trains.
   

  

 We operate in a fast\-paced environment where timing is critical. When a timeline is committed, it is essential that we deliver on time. Delays in delivery can have a direct impact on our company targets and overall success, so timely execution and adherence to schedules is a key component of our delivery initiatives.
   

  

 If you have a passion for delivering successful releases, a background in driving release planning and execution for large\-scale E\-Commerce/CRM/ERP/Cloud Native in\-house digital products, thriving in a fast\-paced digital transformation environment, we want you to be a part of our journey.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 Our mission as the Delivery team within CDI XO is to
 *"enable
 **smooth deliveries***
*of high\-quality digital products on
 **time and budget** 
 in CDI XO, providing
 **transparency** 
 to CAs and CDI stakeholders throughout the software delivery life\-cycle."*
 Therefore as a Release Manager within our Digital Product Organization, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring smooth, timely, uneventful releases across multiple Agile Release Trains in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
   

  

 This position is a mix of:
   

  

* Hands\-on technical leader – requiring constant deep dives into systems, developing extensive knowledge of the technology architecture, and ensuring robust release processes.
* People leader – leading and mentoring a team of Release Engineers who manage technology\-specific releases, fostering collaboration and accountability across the delivery pipeline.


 Core Aspects of Release Management in Our Organization:
   

  

* Communication – Ensure transparency by generating clear release notes for any release exposing features to business or consumers.
* Calendar – Maintenance of a consolidated up\-to\-date release calendar, including freeze periods, enabling proper planning across all product teams.
* Execution – Orchestration of complex technical releases since planning until post go\-live validations, as well as dependency and resource management.
* Operational Efficiency – Continuous exploration of opportunities for automation with Engineering Org to reduce lead time of release execution.
* Governance – Establishment and enforcement of clear guidelines to enable smooth operations and uneventful releases.


**About the CDI Experience Organization:**
 The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end\-users and consumers across both pre\-purchase and post\-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15\+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E\-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Perform deep and long\-term planning of a consolidated CDI XO Release calendar by aligning with all application owners expected release windows, blackout periods, taking into considerations business critical periods, such as Black Friday/Christmas.
* Own and manage the release planning, scheduling, and execution across digital product teams.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, Processes Owners, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers and Delivery Leads to ensure alignment on release timelines.
* Lead and mentor Release Engineers, providing guidance on best practices and career development.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact delivery schedules or product quality.
* Drive continuous improvement in release processes, ensuring efficiency and predictability.
* Act as the central point of contact for release communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned.
* Monitor release performance metrics and provide insights to leadership for decision\-making.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and governance for all releases.


**Who are you:**
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Project Management within digital product organizations.
* Solid experience in driving release planning and execution, preferably in a multiple technology domain such as E\-commerce/CRM/ERP rollouts.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability of making multiple tactical/operational decisions on a daily basis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment where timely execution is critical.
* Experience working with global teams across multiple regions (Europe, APAC, Americas) is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines is highly desirable.
* Sporadic need to cover business critical releases out of regular business hours.


**Where you'll be:**
 This is a full\-time position, based in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Benefits Highlights:**
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award\-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family\-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

 Senior Analyst Business Systems
   

  

 The insights provided are generated by AI and may contain inaccuracies. Please independently verify any critical information before relying on it.
   

  

**Description**
 Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 The
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 serves as a critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams.
 **This role is responsible for translating business needs into detailed, testable technical requirements for both user interface (UI) and API development work.**
 In addition to core business analysis responsibilities, this position performs hands\-on quality assurance activities, including test case creation, execution, defect documentation, and validation of system functionality. The ideal candidate is highly detail\-oriented, excels at clarifying ambiguity, and ensures that delivered solutions align precisely with documented requirements.
   

  

 This role operates in a collaborative Agile environment and partners closely with product owners, developers, and QA to ensure successful delivery of high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non\-functional requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Create clear and succinct technical requirements for:
+ User Interface (UI) components, workflows, validations, and user interactions
+ API functionality, including request/response structures, data mappings, business rules, and integration requirements

* Develop process flows, use cases, data mappings, and system documentation to support development efforts
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and traceable through the development lifecycle
* Facilitate story grooming with engineers and QAs
* Review completed work to confirm alignment with documented requirements
* Collaborate with QA to develop test strategies, test plans, and detailed test cases based on documented requirements
* As needed, execute functional, integration, and regression testing
* Validate UI behavior, data flows, and API responses against defined specifications
* Perform data validation and basic query analysis using SQL to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios and assisting business users


**What You Will Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a hybrid BA/QA role
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications for both UI and API development
* Hands\-on experience writing and executing test cases
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data flows, and system integrations
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to validate and analyze data
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and requirements documentation tools
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organizational skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
* Experience in financial services or other regulated environments
* Comfort working closely with developers while maintaining an independent validation perspective
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
* A proactive approach to identifying requirement gaps and edge cases


 We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

 We’re looking for a SDE III to join Esper, who will be part of a team building Esper’s flagship product, the Esper Foundation for Android, a custom Android\-based operating system built for enterprises, optimized for dedicated Android devices.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer working with the Esper Foundation team, you will play a crucial role in the development, customization, and enhancement of our Android\-based platforms. You will be responsible for designing and implementing software solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and driving the technical direction of Foundation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* xTS Testing: Lead the design, execution, and management of CTS, VTS, and GTS testing to ensure Android compatibility, security, and performance compliance across all Foundation platforms
* Issue Diagnosis \& Resolution: Investigate, analyze, and resolve test failures by collaborating with fellow engineers, ensuring quick resolution and minimal release delays
* Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, execution results, and defect analysis to support continuous improvement and accountability
* Development and Customization: Outside of the primary charter of leading our testing and automation efforts, assist with development of the Esper Foundation for Android product at multiple levels of the stack
* Technical Ownership: Complete technical ownership on some of the Foundation components. Also, become the Subject Matter Expert(SME) for the team.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience
* Experience: 2\-5 years of experience in software development or testing, with a strong focus on Android platform development, AOSP and Android test suites.
* Technical Skills:
* 
+ Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the use of version control systems like Git
+ Proficiency in Java or Kotlin for Android development.
+ Understanding of C/C\+\+ for low\-level programming and system integration.
+ Experience with Android SDK, NDK, and AOSP build systems.
+ Knowledge of Android security architecture and best practices.

* Problem\-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with running Android on x86 hardware or on GSIs is a big plus.
* Experience working at third party, open\-source orgs like LineageOS is a big plus.
* Experience working with CTS tests and building CTS\-compliant Android platforms is desired.
* Experience working on Android OS for GMS certified devices is a huge plus.
* Familiarity with Android Enterprise features and device management APIs and/or experience building Android apps and working in the Enterprise space.
